function barChart(id,arr){
 let c=document.getElementById(id);if(!c)return;
 let x=c.getContext('2d'),w=c.clientWidth||700,h=c.clientHeight||300;
 /* Renderizza a risoluzione superiore alla dimensione CSS: testo e numeri molto piu nitidi anche su monitor ad alta densita. */
 let d=Math.max(2,window.devicePixelRatio||1);

 let rows=arr.slice().sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1]),max=Math.max(...rows.map(a=>a[1]),1);
 const names={'MONZA E DELLA BRIANZA':'MONZA E BRIANZA'};
 let left=Math.min(225,Math.max(195,w*.32)),right=105,top=10,bottom=10;
 let rowH=Math.max(21,(h-top-bottom)/Math.max(rows.length,1));
 rows.forEach((a,i)=>{
   let y=top+i*rowH+rowH/2,barMax=Math.max(45,w-left-right),barW=barMax*(a[1]/max);
   let color=['#2b8cff','#22c88a','#8b5cf6','#f0a500'][i%4];
   x.textBaseline='middle';x.textAlign='right';x.font='600 13px Arial';x.fillStyle='#d7e5f2';
   x.fillText(names[a[0]]||a[0],left-12,y);
   x.fillStyle='rgba(16,44,69,.9)';x.fillRect(left,y-6,barMax,12);
   x.fillStyle=color;x.fillRect(left,y-6,Math.max(4,barW),12);
   x.textAlign='left';x.font='700 13px Arial';x.fillStyle='#f2f7fb';
   x.fillText(a[1].toLocaleString('it-IT'),Math.min(left+barW+10,w-92),y);
 });
}

function barChart(id,arr){
 let c=document.getElementById(id);if(!c)return;
 let x=c.getContext('2d'),w=c.clientWidth||700,h=c.clientHeight||300;
 /* Renderizza a risoluzione superiore alla dimensione CSS: testo e numeri molto piu nitidi anche su monitor ad alta densita. */
 let d=Math.max(2,window.devicePixelRatio||1);
 c.width=Math.round(w*d);c.height=Math.round(h*d);x.setTransform(d,0,0,d,0,0);x.clearRect(0,0,w,h);
 let rows=arr.slice().sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1]),max=Math.max(...rows.map(a=>a[1]),1);
 const names={'MONZA E DELLA BRIANZA':'MONZA E BRIANZA'};
 let left=Math.min(225,Math.max(195,w*.32)),right=105,top=10,bottom=10;
 let rowH=Math.max(21,(h-top-bottom)/Math.max(rows.length,1));
 rows.forEach((a,i)=>{
   let y=top+i*rowH+rowH/2,barMax=Math.max(45,w-left-right),barW=barMax*(a[1]/max);
   let color=['#2b8cff','#22c88a','#8b5cf6','#f0a500'][i%4];
   x.textBaseline='middle';x.textAlign='right';x.font='600 13px Arial';x.fillStyle='#d7e5f2';
   x.fillText(names[a[0]]||a[0],left-12,y);
   x.fillStyle='rgba(16,44,69,.9)';x.fillRect(left,y-6,barMax,12);
   x.fillStyle=color;x.fillRect(left,y-6,Math.max(4,barW),12);
   x.textAlign='left';x.font='700 13px Arial';x.fillStyle='#f2f7fb';
   x.fillText(a[1].toLocaleString('it-IT'),Math.min(left+barW+10,w-92),y);
 });
}

function barChart(id,arr){

 const names={'MONZA E DELLA BRIANZA':'MONZA E BRIANZA'};
 let left=Math.min(225,Math.max(195,w*.32)),right=105,top=10,bottom=10;
 let rowH=Math.max(21,(h-top-bottom)/Math.max(rows.length,1));
 rows.forEach((a,i)=>{
   let y=top+i*rowH+rowH/2,barMax=Math.max(45,w-left-right),barW=barMax*(a[1]/max);
   let color=['#2b8cff','#22c88a','#8b5cf6','#f0a500'][i%4];
   x.textBaseline='middle';x.textAlign='right';x.font='600 13px Arial';x.fillStyle='#d7e5f2';
   x.fillText(names[a[0]]||a[0],left-12,y);
   x.fillStyle='rgba(16,44,69,.9)';x.fillRect(left,y-6,barMax,12);
   x.fillStyle=color;x.fillRect(left,y-6,Math.max(4,barW),12);
   x.textAlign='left';x.font='700 13px Arial';x.fillStyle='#f2f7fb';
   x.fillText(a[1].toLocaleString('it-IT'),Math.min(left+barW+10,w-92),y);
 });
}

function renderCand(){

function addTicketInline(){const prov=document.getElementById('tkProv')?.value||'',a=(document.getElementById('tkA')?.value||'').trim(),b=(document.getElementById('tkB')?.value||'').trim();if(!prov||!a||!b){alert('Compila Provincia, Candidato 1 e Candidato 2.');return;}const ca=CANDS.find(c=>norm(c)===norm(a)),cb=CANDS.find(c=>norm(c)===norm(b));if(!ca||!cb){alert('I due candidati devono essere selezionati dall’elenco dei candidati.');return;}if(ca===cb){alert('Seleziona due candidati diversi.');return;}if(ticketGroups.some(t=>t.prov===prov&&t.candidates.length===2&&t.candidates.includes(ca)&&t.candidates.includes(cb))){alert('Questo ticket esiste già.');return;}ticketGroups.push({id:'T'+Date.now(),prov,candidates:[ca,cb]});saveTickets();renderCand();}

function sumRows(rows){return rows.reduce((n,r)=>n+(Number(r.preferenze)||0),0)}
function pct(n,d){return d?((n/d)*100).toFixed(1)+'%':'0.0%'}

function barChart(id,arr){
 let c=document.getElementById(id);if(!c)return;
 let x=c.getContext('2d'),w=c.clientWidth||700,h=c.clientHeight||300;
 /* Renderizza a risoluzione superiore alla dimensione CSS: testo e numeri molto piu nitidi anche su monitor ad alta densita. */
 let d=Math.max(2,window.devicePixelRatio||1);
 c.width=Math.round(w*d);c.height=Math.round(h*d);x.setTransform(d,0,0,d,0,0);x.clearRect(0,0,w,h);
 let rows=arr.slice().sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1]),max=Math.max(...rows.map(a=>a[1]),1);
 const names={'MONZA E DELLA BRIANZA':'MONZA E BRIANZA'};
 let left=Math.min(225,Math.max(195,w*.32)),right=105,top=10,bottom=10;
 let rowH=Math.max(21,(h-top-bottom)/Math.max(rows.length,1));
 rows.forEach((a,i)=>{
   let y=top+i*rowH+rowH/2,barMax=Math.max(45,w-left-right),barW=barMax*(a[1]/max);
   let color=['#2b8cff','#22c88a','#8b5cf6','#f0a500'][i%4];
   x.textBaseline='middle';x.textAlign='right';x.font='600 13px Arial';x.fillStyle='#d7e5f2';
   x.fillText(names[a[0]]||a[0],left-12,y);
   x.fillStyle='rgba(16,44,69,.9)';x.fillRect(left,y-6,barMax,12);
   x.fillStyle=color;x.fillRect(left,y-6,Math.max(4,barW),12);
   x.textAlign='left';x.font='700 13px Arial';x.fillStyle='#f2f7fb';
   x.fillText(a[1].toLocaleString('it-IT'),Math.min(left+barW+10,w-92),y);
 });
}

  const rows=filtered();
  const totals=agg(rows,r=>r.candidato);
  document.getElementById('prefTable').innerHTML=totals.map((x,i)=>{

    return `<tr class="candidate-total-row"><td>${i+1}</td><td><button class="link-btn candidate-total" onclick="openCandidate(${JSON.stringify(c)})">${esc(c)}</button></td><td><div style="display:flex;gap:6px"><input class="inline-input" value="${esc(corrente==='—'?'':corrente)}" placeholder="Inserisci corrente" onchange="saveCorrente(${JSON.stringify(c)},this.value)"><button class="btn bg2" onclick="saveCorrente(${JSON.stringify(c)},this.previousElementSibling.value)">Salva</button></div></td><td><b>${x[1].toLocaleString('it-IT')}</b></td></tr>`;
  }).join('') || `<tr><td colspan="4"><div class="empty-state"><b>Nessun dato</b><span>Modifica i filtri selezionati.</span></div></td></tr>`;
}
function openCandidate(candidate){
  const rows=data.filter(r=>r.candidato===candidate && (!filters.prov||r.prov===filters.prov) && (!filters.comune||r.comune===filters.comune) && (!filters.lista||r.lista===filters.lista) && (!filters.corrente||r.corrente===filters.corrente));
  const byComune=agg(rows,r=>r.comune);
  const total=byComune.reduce((s,x)=>s+x[1],0);
  const scope=filters.prov?filters.prov:'Tutta la Lombardia';
  const html=`<div class="modal-backdrop candidate-list-modal" onclick="if(event.target===this)closeCandidate()"><div class="modal-card"><div class="modal-head"><div><div class="eyebrow">SCHEDA CANDIDATO · ${esc(electionLabel())}</div><h2>${esc(candidate)}</h2><p>${esc(scope)} · ${total.toLocaleString('it-IT')} preferenze</p></div><button class="btn bg2" onclick="closeCandidate()">Chiudi ✕</button></div><div class="dash-card"><div class="card-title"><div><b>Comuni e preferenze</b><small>Ordinati dal Comune con più preferenze</small></div></div><div class="table-wrap"><table class="data-table"><thead><tr><th>#</th><th>Comune</th><th>Preferenze</th></tr></thead><tbody>${byComune.map((x,i)=>`<tr><td>${i+1}</td><td><button class="link-btn" onclick="closeCandidate();openComune(${esc(JSON.stringify(x[0]))},${JSON.stringify(rows.find(r=>r.comune===x[0])?.prov||'')})"><b>${esc(x[0])}</b></button></td><td><b>${x[1].toLocaleString('it-IT')}</b></td></tr>`).join('')}</tbody><tfoot><tr class="total-row"><td></td><td>TOTALE</td><td>${total.toLocaleString('it-IT')}</td></tr></tfoot></table></div></div></div></div>`;
  document.body.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend',html);
}

function effectiveCurrentTotals(rows){
 const groups={},used=new Set(),out={};
 rows.forEach(r=>{const tg=ticketForCandidate(r.candidato,r.prov); if(tg){if(!groups[tg.id])groups[tg.id]=[]; groups[tg.id].push(r);}});
 rows.forEach(r=>{const tg=ticketForCandidate(r.candidato,r.prov); if(tg){if(used.has(tg.id))return; used.add(tg.id); const rr=groups[tg.id]||[]; const byCand={}; rr.forEach(x=>byCand[x.candidato]=(byCand[x.candidato]||0)+(Number(x.preferenze)||0)); const winner=Object.entries(byCand).sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1])[0]; if(!winner)return; const cur=correnti[winner[0]]||'Da classificare'; out[cur]=(out[cur]||0)+winner[1];} else {const cur=correnti[r.candidato]||'Da classificare'; out[cur]=(out[cur]||0)+(Number(r.preferenze)||0);}});
 return Object.entries(out).sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1]);
}
function effectiveCurrentBy(rows,groupKey){

 rows.forEach(r=>{const g=groupKey(r)||'Da classificare'; const tg=ticketForCandidate(r.candidato,r.prov); if(tg){const k=g+'\u001f'+tg.id; if(!groups[k])groups[k]=[]; groups[k].push(r);} });

function barChart(id,arr){
 let c=document.getElementById(id);if(!c)return;
 let x=c.getContext('2d'),w=c.clientWidth||700,h=c.clientHeight||300;
 /* Renderizza a risoluzione superiore alla dimensione CSS: testo e numeri molto piu nitidi anche su monitor ad alta densita. */
 let d=Math.max(2,window.devicePixelRatio||1);
 c.width=Math.round(w*d);c.height=Math.round(h*d);x.setTransform(d,0,0,d,0,0);x.clearRect(0,0,w,h);
 let rows=arr.slice().sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1]),max=Math.max(...rows.map(a=>a[1]),1);
 const names={'MONZA E DELLA BRIANZA':'MONZA E BRIANZA'};
 let left=Math.min(225,Math.max(195,w*.32)),right=105,top=10,bottom=10;
 let rowH=Math.max(21,(h-top-bottom)/Math.max(rows.length,1));
 rows.forEach((a,i)=>{
   let y=top+i*rowH+rowH/2,barMax=Math.max(45,w-left-right),barW=barMax*(a[1]/max);
   let color=['#2b8cff','#22c88a','#8b5cf6','#f0a500'][i%4];
   x.textBaseline='middle';x.textAlign='right';x.font='600 13px Arial';x.fillStyle='#d7e5f2';
   x.fillText(names[a[0]]||a[0],left-12,y);
   x.fillStyle='rgba(16,44,69,.9)';x.fillRect(left,y-6,barMax,12);
   x.fillStyle=color;x.fillRect(left,y-6,Math.max(4,barW),12);
   x.textAlign='left';x.font='700 13px Arial';x.fillStyle='#f2f7fb';
   x.fillText(a[1].toLocaleString('it-IT'),Math.min(left+barW+10,w-92),y);
 });
}

}

function barChart(id,arr){
 let c=document.getElementById(id);if(!c)return;
 let x=c.getContext('2d'),w=c.clientWidth||700,h=c.clientHeight||300;
 /* Renderizza a risoluzione superiore alla dimensione CSS: testo e numeri molto piu nitidi anche su monitor ad alta densita. */
 let d=Math.max(2,window.devicePixelRatio||1);
 c.width=Math.round(w*d);c.height=Math.round(h*d);x.setTransform(d,0,0,d,0,0);x.clearRect(0,0,w,h);
 let rows=arr.slice().sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1]),max=Math.max(...rows.map(a=>a[1]),1);
 const names={'MONZA E DELLA BRIANZA':'MONZA E BRIANZA'};
 let left=Math.min(225,Math.max(195,w*.32)),right=105,top=10,bottom=10;
 let rowH=Math.max(21,(h-top-bottom)/Math.max(rows.length,1));
 rows.forEach((a,i)=>{
   let y=top+i*rowH+rowH/2,barMax=Math.max(45,w-left-right),barW=barMax*(a[1]/max);
   let color=['#2b8cff','#22c88a','#8b5cf6','#f0a500'][i%4];
   x.textBaseline='middle';x.textAlign='right';x.font='600 13px Arial';x.fillStyle='#d7e5f2';
   x.fillText(names[a[0]]||a[0],left-12,y);
   x.fillStyle='rgba(16,44,69,.9)';x.fillRect(left,y-6,barMax,12);
   x.fillStyle=color;x.fillRect(left,y-6,Math.max(4,barW),12);
   x.textAlign='left';x.font='700 13px Arial';x.fillStyle='#f2f7fb';
   x.fillText(a[1].toLocaleString('it-IT'),Math.min(left+barW+10,w-92),y);
 });
}

function clearF(){filters={prov:'',comune:'',candidato:'',corrente:'',camP:'',senP:'',lista:''};render()}
function filtered(){const fp=filters.prov?norm(filters.prov):'';return data.filter(r=>(!fp||norm(PROV_FULL[PROV_CODE[norm(r.prov)]||r.prov]||r.prov)===fp)&&(!filters.comune||norm(r.comune)===norm(filters.comune))&&(!filters.candidato||r.candidato===filters.candidato)&&(!filters.corrente||r.corrente===filters.corrente)&&(!filters.lista||r.lista===filters.lista)&&(!filters.camP||r.geo?.camP===filters.camP)&&(!filters.senP||r.geo?.senP===filters.senP))}
function filterHTML(){let cm=[...new Set(data.filter(r=>!filters.prov||r.prov===filters.prov).map(r=>r.comune))].sort(),ca=[...CANDS],co=[...new Set(data.map(r=>r.corrente).filter(Boolean))].sort(),li=[...new Set(data.map(r=>r.lista))].sort();return opts('prov','Provincia',PROVS,filters.prov)+opts('comune','Comune',cm,filters.comune)+opts('candidato','Candidato',ca,filters.candidato)+opts('corrente','Corrente',co,filters.corrente)+opts('lista','Lista',li,filters.lista)+opts('camP','Camera P',CAM,filters.camP)+opts('senP','Senato P',SEN,filters.senP)+`<button class="btn bg2" onclick="clearF()">Azzera filtri</button>`}
function agg(rows,key){let m={};rows.forEach(r=>{let k=key(r)||'Da classificare';m[k]=(m[k]||0)+r.preferenze});return Object.entries(m).sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1])}
function renderHome(){document.getElementById('k-pref').textContent=total().toLocaleString('it-IT');document.getElementById('k-comuni').textContent=new Set(GEO.map(g=>g.comune)).size.toLocaleString('it-IT');document.getElementById('k-candidati').textContent=CANDS.length;document.getElementById('k-correnti').textContent=new Set(Object.values(correnti).filter(Boolean)).size;document.getElementById('k-collegi').textContent=CAM.length+SEN.length;let p=agg(data,r=>r.prov),top=agg(data,r=>r.candidato).slice(0,8);document.getElementById('topCandidates').innerHTML=top.map((x,i)=>`<div class="rank-row"><b>${i+1}</b><div><strong>${esc(x[0])}</strong><small>${x[1].toLocaleString('it-IT')} preferenze</small></div><span>${(x[1]/total()*100).toFixed(1)}%</span></div>`).join('');document.getElementById('homeQuick').innerHTML=[['▦','TERRITORIO',GEO.length+' righe territoriali','Comune → collegio'],['♟','CANDIDATI',CANDS.length+' candidati','Corrente modificabile'],['⌖','COLLEGI',CAM.length+' Camera · '+SEN.length+' Senato','P + U'],['↔','CONFRONTO','Europee + Regionali','Pronto per il prossimo dataset']].map(x=>`<div class="quick-item"><span>${x[0]}</span><div><b>${x[1]}</b><small>${x[2]}</small><em>${x[3]}</em></div></div>`).join('');document.getElementById('correnteStatus').innerHTML=`<div class="status-list"><div><b>${CANDS.length}</b><span>candidati</span></div><div><b>${Object.values(correnti).filter(Boolean).length}</b><span>classificati</span></div><div><b>${CANDS.length-Object.values(correnti).filter(Boolean).length}</b><span>da classificare</span></div></div>`;barChart('provChart',p)}
function barChart(id,arr){
 let c=document.getElementById(id);if(!c)return;
 let x=c.getContext('2d'),w=c.clientWidth||700,h=c.clientHeight||300;
 /* Renderizza a risoluzione superiore alla dimensione CSS: testo e numeri molto piu nitidi anche su monitor ad alta densita. */
 let d=Math.max(2,window.devicePixelRatio||1);
 c.width=Math.round(w*d);c.height=Math.round(h*d);x.setTransform(d,0,0,d,0,0);x.clearRect(0,0,w,h);
 let rows=arr.slice().sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1]),max=Math.max(...rows.map(a=>a[1]),1);
 const names={'MONZA E DELLA BRIANZA':'MONZA E BRIANZA'};
 let left=Math.min(225,Math.max(195,w*.32)),right=105,top=10,bottom=10;
 let rowH=Math.max(21,(h-top-bottom)/Math.max(rows.length,1));
 rows.forEach((a,i)=>{
   let y=top+i*rowH+rowH/2,barMax=Math.max(45,w-left-right),barW=barMax*(a[1]/max);
   let color=['#2b8cff','#22c88a','#8b5cf6','#f0a500'][i%4];
   x.textBaseline='middle';x.textAlign='right';x.font='600 13px Arial';x.fillStyle='#d7e5f2';
   x.fillText(names[a[0]]||a[0],left-12,y);
   x.fillStyle='rgba(16,44,69,.9)';x.fillRect(left,y-6,barMax,12);
   x.fillStyle=color;x.fillRect(left,y-6,Math.max(4,barW),12);
   x.textAlign='left';x.font='700 13px Arial';x.fillStyle='#f2f7fb';
   x.fillText(a[1].toLocaleString('it-IT'),Math.min(left+barW+10,w-92),y);
 });
}

function ticketForCandidate(c,prov){return ticketGroups.find(t=>t.prov===prov && t.candidates.includes(c));}
function effectiveCurrentTotals(rows){
 const groups={},used=new Set(),out={};
 rows.forEach(r=>{const tg=ticketForCandidate(r.candidato,r.prov); if(tg){if(!groups[tg.id])groups[tg.id]=[]; groups[tg.id].push(r);}});
 rows.forEach(r=>{const tg=ticketForCandidate(r.candidato,r.prov); if(tg){if(used.has(tg.id))return; used.add(tg.id); const rr=groups[tg.id]||[]; const byCand={}; rr.forEach(x=>byCand[x.candidato]=(byCand[x.candidato]||0)+(Number(x.preferenze)||0)); const winner=Object.entries(byCand).sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1])[0]; if(!winner)return; const cur=correnti[winner[0]]||'Da classificare'; out[cur]=(out[cur]||0)+winner[1];} else {const cur=correnti[r.candidato]||'Da classificare'; out[cur]=(out[cur]||0)+(Number(r.preferenze)||0);}});
 return Object.entries(out).sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1]);
}

function effectiveCurrentTotals(rows){
 const groups={},used=new Set(),out={};
 rows.forEach(r=>{const tg=ticketForCandidate(r.candidato,r.prov); if(tg){if(!groups[tg.id])groups[tg.id]=[]; groups[tg.id].push(r);}});
 rows.forEach(r=>{const tg=ticketForCandidate(r.candidato,r.prov); if(tg){if(used.has(tg.id))return; used.add(tg.id); const rr=groups[tg.id]||[]; const byCand={}; rr.forEach(x=>byCand[x.candidato]=(byCand[x.candidato]||0)+(Number(x.preferenze)||0)); const winner=Object.entries(byCand).sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1])[0]; if(!winner)return; const cur=correnti[winner[0]]||'Da classificare'; out[cur]=(out[cur]||0)+winner[1];} else {const cur=correnti[r.candidato]||'Da classificare'; out[cur]=(out[cur]||0)+(Number(r.preferenze)||0);}});
 return Object.entries(out).sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1]);
}
function effectiveCurrentBy(rows,groupKey){
 const out={}; const groups={}; const used=new Set();
 rows.forEach(r=>{const g=groupKey(r)||'Da classificare'; const tg=ticketForCandidate(r.candidato,r.prov); if(tg){const k=g+'\u001f'+tg.id; if(!groups[k])groups[k]=[]; groups[k].push(r);} });
 rows.forEach(r=>{const g=groupKey(r)||'Da classificare'; const tg=ticketForCandidate(r.candidato,r.prov); if(tg){const k=g+'\u001f'+tg.id; if(used.has(k))return; used.add(k); const byCand={}; (groups[k]||[]).forEach(x=>byCand[x.candidato]=(byCand[x.candidato]||0)+(Number(x.preferenze)||0)); const winner=Object.entries(byCand).sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1])[0]; if(!winner)return; const cur=correnti[winner[0]]||'Da classificare'; if(!out[g])out[g]={}; out[g][cur]=(out[g][cur]||0)+winner[1];} else {const cur=correnti[r.candidato]||'Da classificare'; if(!out[g])out[g]={}; out[g][cur]=(out[g][cur]||0)+(Number(r.preferenze)||0);}});
 return out;
}

function opts(id,label,values,value){return `<label class="filter-control"><span>${label}</span><select onchange="setF('${id}',this.value)"><option value="">Tutti</option>${values.map(v=>`<option ${v===value?'selected':''} value="${esc(v)}">${esc(v)}</option>`).join('')}</select></label>`}

function filtered(){const fp=filters.prov?norm(filters.prov):'';return data.filter(r=>(!fp||norm(PROV_FULL[PROV_CODE[norm(r.prov)]||r.prov]||r.prov)===fp)&&(!filters.comune||norm(r.comune)===norm(filters.comune))&&(!filters.candidato||r.candidato===filters.candidato)&&(!filters.corrente||r.corrente===filters.corrente)&&(!filters.lista||r.lista===filters.lista)&&(!filters.camP||r.geo?.camP===filters.camP)&&(!filters.senP||r.geo?.senP===filters.senP))}
function filterHTML(){let cm=[...new Set(data.filter(r=>!filters.prov||r.prov===filters.prov).map(r=>r.comune))].sort(),ca=[...CANDS],co=[...new Set(data.map(r=>r.corrente).filter(Boolean))].sort(),li=[...new Set(data.map(r=>r.lista))].sort();return opts('prov','Provincia',PROVS,filters.prov)+opts('comune','Comune',cm,filters.comune)+opts('candidato','Candidato',ca,filters.candidato)+opts('corrente','Corrente',co,filters.corrente)+opts('lista','Lista',li,filters.lista)+opts('camP','Camera P',CAM,filters.camP)+opts('senP','Senato P',SEN,filters.senP)+`<button class="btn bg2" onclick="clearF()">Azzera filtri</button>`}
function agg(rows,key){let m={};rows.forEach(r=>{let k=key(r)||'Da classificare';m[k]=(m[k]||0)+r.preferenze});return Object.entries(m).sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1])}
function renderHome(){document.getElementById('k-pref').textContent=total().toLocaleString('it-IT');document.getElementById('k-comuni').textContent=new Set(GEO.map(g=>g.comune)).size.toLocaleString('it-IT');document.getElementById('k-candidati').textContent=CANDS.length;document.getElementById('k-correnti').textContent=new Set(Object.values(correnti).filter(Boolean)).size;document.getElementById('k-collegi').textContent=CAM.length+SEN.length;let p=agg(data,r=>r.prov),top=agg(data,r=>r.candidato).slice(0,8);document.getElementById('topCandidates').innerHTML=top.map((x,i)=>`<div class="rank-row"><b>${i+1}</b><div><strong>${esc(x[0])}</strong><small>${x[1].toLocaleString('it-IT')} preferenze</small></div><span>${(x[1]/total()*100).toFixed(1)}%</span></div>`).join('');document.getElementById('homeQuick').innerHTML=[['▦','TERRITORIO',GEO.length+' righe territoriali','Comune → collegio'],['♟','CANDIDATI',CANDS.length+' candidati','Corrente modificabile'],['⌖','COLLEGI',CAM.length+' Camera · '+SEN.length+' Senato','P + U'],['↔','CONFRONTO','Europee + Regionali','Pronto per il prossimo dataset']].map(x=>`<div class="quick-item"><span>${x[0]}</span><div><b>${x[1]}</b><small>${x[2]}</small><em>${x[3]}</em></div></div>`).join('');document.getElementById('correnteStatus').innerHTML=`<div class="status-list"><div><b>${CANDS.length}</b><span>candidati</span></div><div><b>${Object.values(correnti).filter(Boolean).length}</b><span>classificati</span></div><div><b>${CANDS.length-Object.values(correnti).filter(Boolean).length}</b><span>da classificare</span></div></div>`;barChart('provChart',p)}
function barChart(id,arr){
 let c=document.getElementById(id);if(!c)return;
 let x=c.getContext('2d'),w=c.clientWidth||700,h=c.clientHeight||300;
 /* Renderizza a risoluzione superiore alla dimensione CSS: testo e numeri molto piu nitidi anche su monitor ad alta densita. */
 let d=Math.max(2,window.devicePixelRatio||1);
 c.width=Math.round(w*d);c.height=Math.round(h*d);x.setTransform(d,0,0,d,0,0);x.clearRect(0,0,w,h);
 let rows=arr.slice().sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1]),max=Math.max(...rows.map(a=>a[1]),1);
 const names={'MONZA E DELLA BRIANZA':'MONZA E BRIANZA'};
 let left=Math.min(225,Math.max(195,w*.32)),right=105,top=10,bottom=10;
 let rowH=Math.max(21,(h-top-bottom)/Math.max(rows.length,1));
 rows.forEach((a,i)=>{
   let y=top+i*rowH+rowH/2,barMax=Math.max(45,w-left-right),barW=barMax*(a[1]/max);
   let color=['#2b8cff','#22c88a','#8b5cf6','#f0a500'][i%4];
   x.textBaseline='middle';x.textAlign='right';x.font='600 13px Arial';x.fillStyle='#d7e5f2';
   x.fillText(names[a[0]]||a[0],left-12,y);
   x.fillStyle='rgba(16,44,69,.9)';x.fillRect(left,y-6,barMax,12);
   x.fillStyle=color;x.fillRect(left,y-6,Math.max(4,barW),12);
   x.textAlign='left';x.font='700 13px Arial';x.fillStyle='#f2f7fb';
   x.fillText(a[1].toLocaleString('it-IT'),Math.min(left+barW+10,w-92),y);
 });
}

function barChart(id,arr){
 let c=document.getElementById(id);if(!c)return;
 let x=c.getContext('2d'),w=c.clientWidth||700,h=c.clientHeight||300;
 /* Renderizza a risoluzione superiore alla dimensione CSS: testo e numeri molto piu nitidi anche su monitor ad alta densita. */
 let d=Math.max(2,window.devicePixelRatio||1);
 c.width=Math.round(w*d);c.height=Math.round(h*d);x.setTransform(d,0,0,d,0,0);x.clearRect(0,0,w,h);
 let rows=arr.slice().sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1]),max=Math.max(...rows.map(a=>a[1]),1);
 const names={'MONZA E DELLA BRIANZA':'MONZA E BRIANZA'};
 let left=Math.min(225,Math.max(195,w*.32)),right=105,top=10,bottom=10;
 let rowH=Math.max(21,(h-top-bottom)/Math.max(rows.length,1));
 rows.forEach((a,i)=>{
   let y=top+i*rowH+rowH/2,barMax=Math.max(45,w-left-right),barW=barMax*(a[1]/max);
   let color=['#2b8cff','#22c88a','#8b5cf6','#f0a500'][i%4];
   x.textBaseline='middle';x.textAlign='right';x.font='600 13px Arial';x.fillStyle='#d7e5f2';
   x.fillText(names[a[0]]||a[0],left-12,y);
   x.fillStyle='rgba(16,44,69,.9)';x.fillRect(left,y-6,barMax,12);
   x.fillStyle=color;x.fillRect(left,y-6,Math.max(4,barW),12);
   x.textAlign='left';x.font='700 13px Arial';x.fillStyle='#f2f7fb';
   x.fillText(a[1].toLocaleString('it-IT'),Math.min(left+barW+10,w-92),y);
 });
}

function effectiveCurrentTotals(rows){
 const groups={},used=new Set(),out={};
 rows.forEach(r=>{const tg=ticketForCandidate(r.candidato,r.prov); if(tg){if(!groups[tg.id])groups[tg.id]=[]; groups[tg.id].push(r);}});
 rows.forEach(r=>{const tg=ticketForCandidate(r.candidato,r.prov); if(tg){if(used.has(tg.id))return; used.add(tg.id); const rr=groups[tg.id]||[]; const byCand={}; rr.forEach(x=>byCand[x.candidato]=(byCand[x.candidato]||0)+(Number(x.preferenze)||0)); const winner=Object.entries(byCand).sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1])[0]; if(!winner)return; const cur=correnti[winner[0]]||'Da classificare'; out[cur]=(out[cur]||0)+winner[1];} else {const cur=correnti[r.candidato]||'Da classificare'; out[cur]=(out[cur]||0)+(Number(r.preferenze)||0);}});
 return Object.entries(out).sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1]);
}

function barChart(id,arr){
 let c=document.getElementById(id);if(!c)return;
 let x=c.getContext('2d'),w=c.clientWidth||700,h=c.clientHeight||300;
 /* Renderizza a risoluzione superiore alla dimensione CSS: testo e numeri molto piu nitidi anche su monitor ad alta densita. */
 let d=Math.max(2,window.devicePixelRatio||1);
 c.width=Math.round(w*d);c.height=Math.round(h*d);x.setTransform(d,0,0,d,0,0);x.clearRect(0,0,w,h);
 let rows=arr.slice().sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1]),max=Math.max(...rows.map(a=>a[1]),1);
 const names={'MONZA E DELLA BRIANZA':'MONZA E BRIANZA'};
 let left=Math.min(225,Math.max(195,w*.32)),right=105,top=10,bottom=10;
 let rowH=Math.max(21,(h-top-bottom)/Math.max(rows.length,1));
 rows.forEach((a,i)=>{
   let y=top+i*rowH+rowH/2,barMax=Math.max(45,w-left-right),barW=barMax*(a[1]/max);
   let color=['#2b8cff','#22c88a','#8b5cf6','#f0a500'][i%4];
   x.textBaseline='middle';x.textAlign='right';x.font='600 13px Arial';x.fillStyle='#d7e5f2';
   x.fillText(names[a[0]]||a[0],left-12,y);
   x.fillStyle='rgba(16,44,69,.9)';x.fillRect(left,y-6,barMax,12);
   x.fillStyle=color;x.fillRect(left,y-6,Math.max(4,barW),12);
   x.textAlign='left';x.font='700 13px Arial';x.fillStyle='#f2f7fb';
   x.fillText(a[1].toLocaleString('it-IT'),Math.min(left+barW+10,w-92),y);
 });
}

function barChart(id,arr){
 let c=document.getElementById(id);if(!c)return;
 let x=c.getContext('2d'),w=c.clientWidth||700,h=c.clientHeight||300;
 /* Renderizza a risoluzione superiore alla dimensione CSS: testo e numeri molto piu nitidi anche su monitor ad alta densita. */
 let d=Math.max(2,window.devicePixelRatio||1);
 c.width=Math.round(w*d);c.height=Math.round(h*d);x.setTransform(d,0,0,d,0,0);x.clearRect(0,0,w,h);
 let rows=arr.slice().sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1]),max=Math.max(...rows.map(a=>a[1]),1);
 const names={'MONZA E DELLA BRIANZA':'MONZA E BRIANZA'};
 let left=Math.min(225,Math.max(195,w*.32)),right=105,top=10,bottom=10;
 let rowH=Math.max(21,(h-top-bottom)/Math.max(rows.length,1));
 rows.forEach((a,i)=>{
   let y=top+i*rowH+rowH/2,barMax=Math.max(45,w-left-right),barW=barMax*(a[1]/max);
   let color=['#2b8cff','#22c88a','#8b5cf6','#f0a500'][i%4];
   x.textBaseline='middle';x.textAlign='right';x.font='600 13px Arial';x.fillStyle='#d7e5f2';
   x.fillText(names[a[0]]||a[0],left-12,y);
   x.fillStyle='rgba(16,44,69,.9)';x.fillRect(left,y-6,barMax,12);
   x.fillStyle=color;x.fillRect(left,y-6,Math.max(4,barW),12);
   x.textAlign='left';x.font='700 13px Arial';x.fillStyle='#f2f7fb';
   x.fillText(a[1].toLocaleString('it-IT'),Math.min(left+barW+10,w-92),y);
 });
}

 return Object.entries(out).sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1]);
}

function barChart(id,arr){
 let c=document.getElementById(id);if(!c)return;
 let x=c.getContext('2d'),w=c.clientWidth||700,h=c.clientHeight||300;
 /* Renderizza a risoluzione superiore alla dimensione CSS: testo e numeri molto piu nitidi anche su monitor ad alta densita. */
 let d=Math.max(2,window.devicePixelRatio||1);
 c.width=Math.round(w*d);c.height=Math.round(h*d);x.setTransform(d,0,0,d,0,0);x.clearRect(0,0,w,h);
 let rows=arr.slice().sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1]),max=Math.max(...rows.map(a=>a[1]),1);
 const names={'MONZA E DELLA BRIANZA':'MONZA E BRIANZA'};
 let left=Math.min(225,Math.max(195,w*.32)),right=105,top=10,bottom=10;
 let rowH=Math.max(21,(h-top-bottom)/Math.max(rows.length,1));
 rows.forEach((a,i)=>{
   let y=top+i*rowH+rowH/2,barMax=Math.max(45,w-left-right),barW=barMax*(a[1]/max);
   let color=['#2b8cff','#22c88a','#8b5cf6','#f0a500'][i%4];
   x.textBaseline='middle';x.textAlign='right';x.font='600 13px Arial';x.fillStyle='#d7e5f2';
   x.fillText(names[a[0]]||a[0],left-12,y);
   x.fillStyle='rgba(16,44,69,.9)';x.fillRect(left,y-6,barMax,12);
   x.fillStyle=color;x.fillRect(left,y-6,Math.max(4,barW),12);
   x.textAlign='left';x.font='700 13px Arial';x.fillStyle='#f2f7fb';
   x.fillText(a[1].toLocaleString('it-IT'),Math.min(left+barW+10,w-92),y);
 });
}

  }).join('') || `<tr><td colspan="4"><div class="empty-state"><b>Nessun dato</b><span>Modifica i filtri selezionati.</span></div></td></tr>`;

function barChart(id,arr){
 let c=document.getElementById(id);if(!c)return;
 let x=c.getContext('2d'),w=c.clientWidth||700,h=c.clientHeight||300;
 /* Renderizza a risoluzione superiore alla dimensione CSS: testo e numeri molto piu nitidi anche su monitor ad alta densita. */
 let d=Math.max(2,window.devicePixelRatio||1);
 c.width=Math.round(w*d);c.height=Math.round(h*d);x.setTransform(d,0,0,d,0,0);x.clearRect(0,0,w,h);
 let rows=arr.slice().sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1]),max=Math.max(...rows.map(a=>a[1]),1);
 const names={'MONZA E DELLA BRIANZA':'MONZA E BRIANZA'};
 let left=Math.min(225,Math.max(195,w*.32)),right=105,top=10,bottom=10;
 let rowH=Math.max(21,(h-top-bottom)/Math.max(rows.length,1));
 rows.forEach((a,i)=>{
   let y=top+i*rowH+rowH/2,barMax=Math.max(45,w-left-right),barW=barMax*(a[1]/max);
   let color=['#2b8cff','#22c88a','#8b5cf6','#f0a500'][i%4];
   x.textBaseline='middle';x.textAlign='right';x.font='600 13px Arial';x.fillStyle='#d7e5f2';
   x.fillText(names[a[0]]||a[0],left-12,y);
   x.fillStyle='rgba(16,44,69,.9)';x.fillRect(left,y-6,barMax,12);
   x.fillStyle=color;x.fillRect(left,y-6,Math.max(4,barW),12);
   x.textAlign='left';x.font='700 13px Arial';x.fillStyle='#f2f7fb';
   x.fillText(a[1].toLocaleString('it-IT'),Math.min(left+barW+10,w-92),y);
 });
}

 rows.forEach(r=>{const tg=ticketForCandidate(r.candidato,r.prov); if(tg){if(used.has(tg.id))return; used.add(tg.id); const rr=groups[tg.id]||[]; const byCand={}; rr.forEach(x=>byCand[x.candidato]=(byCand[x.candidato]||0)+(Number(x.preferenze)||0)); const winner=Object.entries(byCand).sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1])[0]; if(!winner)return; const cur=correnti[winner[0]]||'Da classificare'; out[cur]=(out[cur]||0)+winner[1];} else {const cur=correnti[r.candidato]||'Da classificare'; out[cur]=(out[cur]||0)+(Number(r.preferenze)||0);}});
 return Object.entries(out).sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1]);
}
function effectiveCurrentBy(rows,groupKey){
 const out={}; const groups={}; const used=new Set();
 rows.forEach(r=>{const g=groupKey(r)||'Da classificare'; const tg=ticketForCandidate(r.candidato,r.prov); if(tg){const k=g+'\u001f'+tg.id; if(!groups[k])groups[k]=[]; groups[k].push(r);} });
 rows.forEach(r=>{const g=groupKey(r)||'Da classificare'; const tg=ticketForCandidate(r.candidato,r.prov); if(tg){const k=g+'\u001f'+tg.id; if(used.has(k))return; used.add(k); const byCand={}; (groups[k]||[]).forEach(x=>byCand[x.candidato]=(byCand[x.candidato]||0)+(Number(x.preferenze)||0)); const winner=Object.entries(byCand).sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1])[0]; if(!winner)return; const cur=correnti[winner[0]]||'Da classificare'; if(!out[g])out[g]={}; out[g][cur]=(out[g][cur]||0)+winner[1];} else {const cur=correnti[r.candidato]||'Da classificare'; if(!out[g])out[g]={}; out[g][cur]=(out[g][cur]||0)+(Number(r.preferenze)||0);}});
 return out;
}

function barChart(id,arr){
 let c=document.getElementById(id);if(!c)return;
 let x=c.getContext('2d'),w=c.clientWidth||700,h=c.clientHeight||300;
 /* Renderizza a risoluzione superiore alla dimensione CSS: testo e numeri molto piu nitidi anche su monitor ad alta densita. */
 let d=Math.max(2,window.devicePixelRatio||1);
 c.width=Math.round(w*d);c.height=Math.round(h*d);x.setTransform(d,0,0,d,0,0);x.clearRect(0,0,w,h);
 let rows=arr.slice().sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1]),max=Math.max(...rows.map(a=>a[1]),1);
 const names={'MONZA E DELLA BRIANZA':'MONZA E BRIANZA'};
 let left=Math.min(225,Math.max(195,w*.32)),right=105,top=10,bottom=10;
 let rowH=Math.max(21,(h-top-bottom)/Math.max(rows.length,1));
 rows.forEach((a,i)=>{
   let y=top+i*rowH+rowH/2,barMax=Math.max(45,w-left-right),barW=barMax*(a[1]/max);
   let color=['#2b8cff','#22c88a','#8b5cf6','#f0a500'][i%4];
   x.textBaseline='middle';x.textAlign='right';x.font='600 13px Arial';x.fillStyle='#d7e5f2';
   x.fillText(names[a[0]]||a[0],left-12,y);
   x.fillStyle='rgba(16,44,69,.9)';x.fillRect(left,y-6,barMax,12);
   x.fillStyle=color;x.fillRect(left,y-6,Math.max(4,barW),12);
   x.textAlign='left';x.font='700 13px Arial';x.fillStyle='#f2f7fb';
   x.fillText(a[1].toLocaleString('it-IT'),Math.min(left+barW+10,w-92),y);
 });
}

   x.fillStyle='rgba(16,44,69,.9)';x.fillRect(left,y-6,barMax,12);
   x.fillStyle=color;x.fillRect(left,y-6,Math.max(4,barW),12);
   x.textAlign='left';x.font='700 13px Arial';x.fillStyle='#f2f7fb';
   x.fillText(a[1].toLocaleString('it-IT'),Math.min(left+barW+10,w-92),y);
 });
}

function filterHTML(){let cm=[...new Set(data.filter(r=>!filters.prov||r.prov===filters.prov).map(r=>r.comune))].sort(),ca=[...CANDS],co=[...new Set(data.map(r=>r.corrente).filter(Boolean))].sort(),li=[...new Set(data.map(r=>r.lista))].sort();return opts('prov','Provincia',PROVS,filters.prov)+opts('comune','Comune',cm,filters.comune)+opts('candidato','Candidato',ca,filters.candidato)+opts('corrente','Corrente',co,filters.corrente)+opts('lista','Lista',li,filters.lista)+opts('camP','Camera P',CAM,filters.camP)+opts('senP','Senato P',SEN,filters.senP)+`<button class="btn bg2" onclick="clearF()">Azzera filtri</button>`}
function agg(rows,key){let m={};rows.forEach(r=>{let k=key(r)||'Da classificare';m[k]=(m[k]||0)+r.preferenze});return Object.entries(m).sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1])}
function renderHome(){document.getElementById('k-pref').textContent=total().toLocaleString('it-IT');document.getElementById('k-comuni').textContent=new Set(GEO.map(g=>g.comune)).size.toLocaleString('it-IT');document.getElementById('k-candidati').textContent=CANDS.length;document.getElementById('k-correnti').textContent=new Set(Object.values(correnti).filter(Boolean)).size;document.getElementById('k-collegi').textContent=CAM.length+SEN.length;let p=agg(data,r=>r.prov),top=agg(data,r=>r.candidato).slice(0,8);document.getElementById('topCandidates').innerHTML=top.map((x,i)=>`<div class="rank-row"><b>${i+1}</b><div><strong>${esc(x[0])}</strong><small>${x[1].toLocaleString('it-IT')} preferenze</small></div><span>${(x[1]/total()*100).toFixed(1)}%</span></div>`).join('');document.getElementById('homeQuick').innerHTML=[['▦','TERRITORIO',GEO.length+' righe territoriali','Comune → collegio'],['♟','CANDIDATI',CANDS.length+' candidati','Corrente modificabile'],['⌖','COLLEGI',CAM.length+' Camera · '+SEN.length+' Senato','P + U'],['↔','CONFRONTO','Europee + Regionali','Pronto per il prossimo dataset']].map(x=>`<div class="quick-item"><span>${x[0]}</span><div><b>${x[1]}</b><small>${x[2]}</small><em>${x[3]}</em></div></div>`).join('');document.getElementById('correnteStatus').innerHTML=`<div class="status-list"><div><b>${CANDS.length}</b><span>candidati</span></div><div><b>${Object.values(correnti).filter(Boolean).length}</b><span>classificati</span></div><div><b>${CANDS.length-Object.values(correnti).filter(Boolean).length}</b><span>da classificare</span></div></div>`;barChart('provChart',p)}
function barChart(id,arr){
 let c=document.getElementById(id);if(!c)return;
 let x=c.getContext('2d'),w=c.clientWidth||700,h=c.clientHeight||300;
 /* Renderizza a risoluzione superiore alla dimensione CSS: testo e numeri molto piu nitidi anche su monitor ad alta densita. */
 let d=Math.max(2,window.devicePixelRatio||1);
 c.width=Math.round(w*d);c.height=Math.round(h*d);x.setTransform(d,0,0,d,0,0);x.clearRect(0,0,w,h);
 let rows=arr.slice().sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1]),max=Math.max(...rows.map(a=>a[1]),1);
 const names={'MONZA E DELLA BRIANZA':'MONZA E BRIANZA'};
 let left=Math.min(225,Math.max(195,w*.32)),right=105,top=10,bottom=10;
 let rowH=Math.max(21,(h-top-bottom)/Math.max(rows.length,1));
 rows.forEach((a,i)=>{
   let y=top+i*rowH+rowH/2,barMax=Math.max(45,w-left-right),barW=barMax*(a[1]/max);
   let color=['#2b8cff','#22c88a','#8b5cf6','#f0a500'][i%4];
   x.textBaseline='middle';x.textAlign='right';x.font='600 13px Arial';x.fillStyle='#d7e5f2';
   x.fillText(names[a[0]]||a[0],left-12,y);
   x.fillStyle='rgba(16,44,69,.9)';x.fillRect(left,y-6,barMax,12);
   x.fillStyle=color;x.fillRect(left,y-6,Math.max(4,barW),12);
   x.textAlign='left';x.font='700 13px Arial';x.fillStyle='#f2f7fb';
   x.fillText(a[1].toLocaleString('it-IT'),Math.min(left+barW+10,w-92),y);
 });
}
function renderPref(){
  document.getElementById('prefFilters').innerHTML=filterHTML();
  const rows=filtered();
  const totals=agg(rows,r=>r.candidato);
  document.getElementById('prefTable').innerHTML=totals.map((x,i)=>{
    const c=x[0], corrente=correnti[c]||'—';
    return `<tr class="candidate-total-row"><td>${i+1}</td><td><button class="link-btn candidate-total" onclick="openCandidate(${JSON.stringify(c)})">${esc(c)}</button></td><td><div style="display:flex;gap:6px"><input class="inline-input" value="${esc(corrente==='—'?'':corrente)}" placeholder="Inserisci corrente" onchange="saveCorrente(${JSON.stringify(c)},this.value)"><button class="btn bg2" onclick="saveCorrente(${JSON.stringify(c)},this.previousElementSibling.value)">Salva</button></div></td><td><b>${x[1].toLocaleString('it-IT')}</b></td></tr>`;
  }).join('') || `<tr><td colspan="4"><div class="empty-state"><b>Nessun dato</b><span>Modifica i filtri selezionati.</span></div></td></tr>`;
}
function openCandidate(candidate){
  const rows=data.filter(r=>r.candidato===candidate && (!filters.prov||r.prov===filters.prov) && (!filters.comune||r.comune===filters.comune) && (!filters.lista||r.lista===filters.lista) && (!filters.corrente||r.corrente===filters.corrente));
  const byComune=agg(rows,r=>r.comune);
  const total=byComune.reduce((s,x)=>s+x[1],0);
  const scope=filters.prov?filters.prov:'Tutta la Lombardia';
  const html=`<div class="modal-backdrop candidate-list-modal" onclick="if(event.target===this)closeCandidate()"><div class="modal-card"><div class="modal-head"><div><div class="eyebrow">SCHEDA CANDIDATO · ${esc(electionLabel())}</div><h2>${esc(candidate)}</h2><p>${esc(scope)} · ${total.toLocaleString('it-IT')} preferenze</p></div><button class="btn bg2" onclick="closeCandidate()">Chiudi ✕</button></div><div class="dash-card"><div class="card-title"><div><b>Comuni e preferenze</b><small>Ordinati dal Comune con più preferenze</small></div></div><div class="table-wrap"><table class="data-table"><thead><tr><th>#</th><th>Comune</th><th>Preferenze</th></tr></thead><tbody>${byComune.map((x,i)=>`<tr><td>${i+1}</td><td><button class="link-btn" onclick="closeCandidate();openComune(${esc(JSON.stringify(x[0]))},${JSON.stringify(rows.find(r=>r.comune===x[0])?.prov||'')})"><b>${esc(x[0])}</b></button></td><td><b>${x[1].toLocaleString('it-IT')}</b></td></tr>`).join('')}</tbody><tfoot><tr class="total-row"><td></td><td>TOTALE</td><td>${total.toLocaleString('it-IT')}</td></tr></tfoot></table></div></div></div></div>`;
  document.body.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend',html);
}

  }).join('') || `<tr><td colspan="4"><div class="empty-state"><b>Nessun dato</b><span>Modifica i filtri selezionati.</span></div></td></tr>`;

function openCandidate(candidate){
  const rows=data.filter(r=>r.candidato===candidate && (!filters.prov||r.prov===filters.prov) && (!filters.comune||r.comune===filters.comune) && (!filters.lista||r.lista===filters.lista) && (!filters.corrente||r.corrente===filters.corrente));
  const byComune=agg(rows,r=>r.comune);
  const total=byComune.reduce((s,x)=>s+x[1],0);
  const scope=filters.prov?filters.prov:'Tutta la Lombardia';
  const html=`<div class="modal-backdrop candidate-list-modal" onclick="if(event.target===this)closeCandidate()"><div class="modal-card"><div class="modal-head"><div><div class="eyebrow">SCHEDA CANDIDATO · ${esc(electionLabel())}</div><h2>${esc(candidate)}</h2><p>${esc(scope)} · ${total.toLocaleString('it-IT')} preferenze</p></div><button class="btn bg2" onclick="closeCandidate()">Chiudi ✕</button></div><div class="dash-card"><div class="card-title"><div><b>Comuni e preferenze</b><small>Ordinati dal Comune con più preferenze</small></div></div><div class="table-wrap"><table class="data-table"><thead><tr><th>#</th><th>Comune</th><th>Preferenze</th></tr></thead><tbody>${byComune.map((x,i)=>`<tr><td>${i+1}</td><td><button class="link-btn" onclick="closeCandidate();openComune(${esc(JSON.stringify(x[0]))},${JSON.stringify(rows.find(r=>r.comune===x[0])?.prov||'')})"><b>${esc(x[0])}</b></button></td><td><b>${x[1].toLocaleString('it-IT')}</b></td></tr>`).join('')}</tbody><tfoot><tr class="total-row"><td></td><td>TOTALE</td><td>${total.toLocaleString('it-IT')}</td></tr></tfoot></table></div></div></div></div>`;
  document.body.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend',html);
}

function addTicketInline(){const prov=document.getElementById('tkProv')?.value||'',a=(document.getElementById('tkA')?.value||'').trim(),b=(document.getElementById('tkB')?.value||'').trim();if(!prov||!a||!b){alert('Compila Provincia, Candidato 1 e Candidato 2.');return;}const ca=CANDS.find(c=>norm(c)===norm(a)),cb=CANDS.find(c=>norm(c)===norm(b));if(!ca||!cb){alert('I due candidati devono essere selezionati dall’elenco dei candidati.');return;}if(ca===cb){alert('Seleziona due candidati diversi.');return;}if(ticketGroups.some(t=>t.prov===prov&&t.candidates.length===2&&t.candidates.includes(ca)&&t.candidates.includes(cb))){alert('Questo ticket esiste già.');return;}ticketGroups.push({id:'T'+Date.now(),prov,candidates:[ca,cb]});saveTickets();renderCand();}

function listBars(a){let m=Math.max(...a.map(x=>x[1]),1);return a.map(x=>`<div class="list-bar"><span>${esc(x[0])}</span><i><em style="width:${x[1]/m*100}%"></em></i><b>${x[1].toLocaleString('it-IT')}</b></div>`).join('')||'<span class="muted">Nessun dato</span>'}

function sumRows(rows){return rows.reduce((n,r)=>n+(Number(r.preferenze)||0),0)}
function pct(n,d){return d?((n/d)*100).toFixed(1)+'%':'0.0%'}
function groupRows(rows,key){let m={};rows.forEach(r=>{let k=key(r)||'Da classificare';m[k]=(m[k]||0)+(Number(r.preferenze)||0)});return Object.entries(m).sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1])}
function analysisRowClick(type,value){if(type==='camP'){filters.camP=value;filters.senP=''}else if(type==='senP'){filters.senP=value;filters.camP=''}else if(type==='candidato'){filters.candidato=value}render()}

function searchGlobal(){let q=prompt('Cerca comune, candidato o collegio:');if(!q)return;let n=norm(q),c=CANDS.find(x=>norm(x).includes(n)),g=GEO.find(x=>norm(x.comune).includes(n));if(c){filters={prov:'',comune:'',candidato:c,corrente:'',camP:'',senP:'',lista:''};tab('preferenze',document.querySelector('[onclick*=preferenze]'))}else if(g){filters={...filters,prov:g.prov,comune:g.comune};tab('comuni',document.querySelector('[onclick*=comuni]'))}else alert('Nessun risultato')}
function exportCSV(){let rows=filtered(),out='PROVINCIA;COMUNE;CANDIDATO;LISTA;CORRENTE;PREFERENZE;CAMERA_P;SENATO_P\n'+rows.map(r=>[r.prov,r.comune,r.candidato,r.lista,r.corrente||'',r.preferenze,r.geo?.camP||'',r.geo?.senP||''].map(v=>`"${String(v).replace(/"/g,'""')}"`).join(';')).join('\n');download(out,'preferenze_lombardia_filtrate.csv','text/csv;charset=utf-8')}
function exportAnalysis(){let a=agg(filtered(),r=>r.corrente),out='CORRENTE;PREFERENZE\n'+a.map(x=>`"${x[0]}";${x[1]}`).join('\n');download(out,'analisi_correnti_lombardia.csv','text/csv;charset=utf-8')}

function toggleTheme(){document.body.classList.toggle('light-mode')}

function exportAnalysisAdvanced(){const r=filtered(),out=['TIPO;NOME;PREFERENZE;PERCENTUALE'];groupRows(r,x=>x.corrente).forEach(x=>out.push(`CORRENTE;"${String(x[0]).replace(/"/g,'""')}";${x[1]};${pct(x[1],sumRows(r))}`));groupRows(r,x=>x.candidato).forEach(x=>out.push(`CANDIDATO;"${String(x[0]).replace(/"/g,'""')}";${x[1]};${pct(x[1],sumRows(r))}`));groupRows(r,x=>x.geo?.camP).forEach(x=>out.push(`CAMERA;"${String(x[0]).replace(/"/g,'""')}";${x[1]};${pct(x[1],sumRows(r))}`));groupRows(r,x=>x.geo?.senP).forEach(x=>out.push(`SENATO;"${String(x[0]).replace(/"/g,'""')}";${x[1]};${pct(x[1],sumRows(r))}`));download(out.join('\n'),'analisi_avanzata_lombardia.csv','text/csv;charset=utf-8')}

function renderCorrenti(){let a=effectiveCurrentTotals(data),t=a.reduce((s,x)=>s+x[1],0);document.getElementById('correntiTable').innerHTML=a.map(x=>`<tr><td><b>${esc(x[0])}</b></td><td>${new Set(data.filter(r=>(correnti[r.candidato]||'Da classificare')===x[0]).map(r=>r.candidato)).size}</td><td>${x[1].toLocaleString('it-IT')}</td><td>${t?((x[1]/t)*100).toFixed(2):'0.00'}%</td></tr>`).join('')} 
function render(){applyCorrenti();renderHome();if(current==='preferenze')renderPref();if(current==='comuni')renderComuni();if(current==='candidati')renderCand();if(current==='collegi')renderCollegi();if(current==='analisi')renderAnalisi();if(current==='correnti')renderCorrenti()}
function searchGlobal(){let q=prompt('Cerca comune, candidato o collegio:');if(!q)return;let n=norm(q),c=CANDS.find(x=>norm(x).includes(n)),g=GEO.find(x=>norm(x.comune).includes(n));if(c){filters={prov:'',comune:'',candidato:c,corrente:'',camP:'',senP:'',lista:''};tab('preferenze',document.querySelector('[onclick*=preferenze]'))}else if(g){filters={...filters,prov:g.prov,comune:g.comune};tab('comuni',document.querySelector('[onclick*=comuni]'))}else alert('Nessun risultato')}
function exportCSV(){let rows=filtered(),out='PROVINCIA;COMUNE;CANDIDATO;LISTA;CORRENTE;PREFERENZE;CAMERA_P;SENATO_P\n'+rows.map(r=>[r.prov,r.comune,r.candidato,r.lista,r.corrente||'',r.preferenze,r.geo?.camP||'',r.geo?.senP||''].map(v=>`"${String(v).replace(/"/g,'""')}"`).join(';')).join('\n');download(out,'preferenze_lombardia_filtrate.csv','text/csv;charset=utf-8')}
function exportAnalysis(){let a=agg(filtered(),r=>r.corrente),out='CORRENTE;PREFERENZE\n'+a.map(x=>`"${x[0]}";${x[1]}`).join('\n');download(out,'analisi_correnti_lombardia.csv','text/csv;charset=utf-8')}
function download(t,n,m){let a=document.createElement('a');a.href=URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([t],{type:m}));a.download=n;a.click()}
function toggleTheme(){document.body.classList.toggle('light-mode')}
function resetCorrenti(){if(confirm('Cancellare tutte le correnti assegnate?')){correnti={};localStorage.removeItem('lombardia_correnti_2026');ticketGroups=[];localStorage.removeItem('lombardia_ticket_2026');render()}}
render();

  if(title) title.textContent=v==='europee'?'DATI EUROPEE · 2024':'DATI REGIONALI · 2023';

  render();
}

function openComune(comune,prov){
 const provCode=PROV_CODE[norm(prov)]||prov;
 const provFull=PROV_FULL[provCode]||prov;
 const matchRows=(arr)=>{
   let rows=arr.filter(r=>norm(r.comune)===norm(comune) && (norm(r.prov)===norm(provCode)||norm(r.prov)===norm(provFull)||norm(PROV_FULL[r.prov]||'')===norm(provFull)));
   if(!rows.length) rows=arr.filter(r=>norm(r.comune)===norm(comune));
   return rows;
 };
 const regionaliRows=matchRows(RAW);
 const europeeRows=matchRows(EURO_RAW);
 const rankingRegionali=agg(regionaliRows,r=>r.candidato);

    const wanted=N(name);

 const html=`<div class="modal-backdrop" onclick="if(event.target===this)closeComune()"><div class="modal-card" style="max-width:1100px"><div class="modal-head"><div><div class="eyebrow">SCHEDA COMUNE</div><h2>${esc(comune)}</h2><p>${esc(provFull)} · ${esc(geo?.istat||'')}</p></div><button class="btn bg2" onclick="closeComune()">Chiudi ✕</button></div><div class="modal-grid"><div class="dash-card"><div class="card-title"><div><b>REGIONALI LOMBARDIA 2023</b><small>Preferenze per candidato · ${regionaliRows.length ? regionaliRows.length+' righe' : 'nessun dato'}</small></div></div>${renderRank(regionaliRows)}</div><div class="dash-card"><div class="card-title"><div><b>EUROPEE 2024</b><small>Preferenze per candidato · ${europeeRows.length ? europeeRows.length+' righe' : 'nessun dato'}</small></div></div>${renderRank(europeeRows)}</div></div></div></div>`;
 document.body.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend',html);
}

function renderComuni(){
 document.getElementById('comuneFilters').innerHTML=filterHTML();
 let sums={}; filtered().forEach(r=>{let k=r.prov+'|'+r.comune;sums[k]=(sums[k]||0)+r.preferenze});
 let rows=GEO.filter(g=>(!filters.prov||PROV_FULL[g.prov]===filters.prov||g.prov===filters.prov)&&(!filters.comune||g.comune===filters.comune)&&(!filters.camP||g.camP===filters.camP)&&(!filters.senP||g.senP===filters.senP)).sort((a,b)=>a.comune.localeCompare(b.comune));
 document.getElementById('comuneTable').innerHTML=rows.map(g=>{let p=PROV_FULL[g.prov]||g.prov;return `<tr><td><button type="button" class="link-btn comune-matrix-btn" data-comune="${esc(g.comune).replace(/"/g,'&quot;')}" data-prov="${esc(p).replace(/"/g,'&quot;')}"><b>${esc(g.comune)}</b></button></td><td>${esc(p)}</td><td>${esc(g.istat)}</td><td>${esc(g.camP)}</td><td>${esc(g.camU)}</td><td>${esc(g.senP)}</td><td>${esc(g.senU)}</td><td><b>${(sums[p+'|'+g.comune]||sums[g.prov+'|'+g.comune]||0).toLocaleString('it-IT')}</b></td></tr>`}).join(''); document.querySelectorAll('.comune-matrix-btn').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',e=>{e.preventDefault();window.openComuneCompare(b.dataset.comune,b.dataset.prov)}));

function renderMatrice(){
  const prov=filters.prov||PROVS[0];
  document.getElementById('matrixFilters').innerHTML=opts('prov','Provincia',PROVS,prov)+`<button class="btn bg2" onclick="filters.prov='';renderMatrice()">Azzera</button>`;
  const provCode=PROV_CODE[norm(prov)]||prov; const rows=data.filter(r=>norm(r.prov)===norm(provCode)||norm(PROV_FULL[r.prov]||r.prov)===norm(prov));
  const cand=agg(rows,r=>r.candidato).map(x=>x[0]);
  const communes=[...new Set(rows.map(r=>r.comune))].sort((a,b)=>a.localeCompare(b,'it'));
  const lookup=new Map(rows.map(r=>[r.comune+'|'+r.candidato,r.preferenze]));
  const totals=cand.map(c=>rows.filter(r=>r.candidato===c).reduce((s,r)=>s+r.preferenze,0));
  document.getElementById('matrixWrap').innerHTML=`<table class="data-table matrix-table"><thead><tr><th class="sticky-col">Comune</th>${cand.map((c,i)=>`<th title="${esc(c)}">${i+1}. ${esc(c)}</th>`).join('')}</tr></thead><tbody>${communes.map(cm=>{let cmx=encodeURIComponent(cm),pvx=encodeURIComponent(prov);return `<tr><td class="sticky-col"><button type="button" class="link-btn matrix-comune-btn" data-comune="${esc(cm).replace(/"/g,'&quot;')}" data-prov="${esc(prov).replace(/"/g,'&quot;')}"><b>${esc(cm)}</b></button></td>${cand.map(c=>`<td>${(lookup.get(cm+'|'+c)||0).toLocaleString('it-IT')}</td>`).join('')}</tr>`}).join('')}<tr class="total-row"><td class="sticky-col"><b>TOTALE PREFERENZE</b></td>${totals.map(v=>`<td><b>${v.toLocaleString('it-IT')}</b></td>`).join('')}</tr></tbody></table>`; document.querySelectorAll('.matrix-comune-btn').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',e=>{e.preventDefault();window.openComuneCompare(b.dataset.comune,b.dataset.prov)}));
}

function renderHome(){

 document.querySelector('.home-toolbar-left small').textContent=electionLabel()+' · FdI';
}

setElectionData();
document.querySelectorAll('.macro-tab').forEach(x=>x.classList.toggle('active',x.id==='macro-regionali'));

    };

    document.querySelectorAll('.collegio-card').forEach(btn=>{
      btn.addEventListener('click',()=>window.openCollegio(btn.dataset.collegioKey,btn.dataset.collegioName));
    });
  };

  window.openCollegio=function(key,name){
    const wanted=N(name);

    const label=key==='camP'?'Camera':'Senato';

    const body=rows||`<tr><td colspan="4"><div class="empty-state"><b>Nessun comune associato.</b><span>Il collegio esiste nella struttura ma non è stato trovato un abbinamento territoriale.</span></div></td></tr>`;
    const html=`<div class="modal-backdrop collegio-detail-modal" onclick="if(event.target===this)window.closeCollegio()"><div class="modal-card"><div class="modal-head"><div><div class="eyebrow">${label}</div><h2>${esc0(title)}</h2><p><b>${gs.length}</b> comuni associati · clicca un comune per vedere Europee e Regionali</p></div><button type="button" class="btn bg2" onclick="window.closeCollegio()">Chiudi ✕</button></div><div class="dash-card"><div class="table-wrap"><table class="data-table

===== Correnti @ 5989011 =====
 class="rank-row"><b>${i+1}</b><div><strong>${esc(x[0])}</strong></div><span>${x[1].toLocaleString('it-IT')}</span></div>`).join('')||'<div class="empty-state">Nessuna preferenza disponibile per questo comune</div>';
 const html=`<div class="modal-backdrop" onclick="if(event.target===this)closeComune()"><div class="modal-card" style="max-width:1100px"><div class="modal-head"><div><div class="eyebrow">SCHEDA COMUNE</div><h2>${esc(comune)}</h2><p>${esc(provFull)} · ${esc(geo?.istat||'')}</p></div><button class="btn bg2" onclick="closeComune()">Chiudi ✕</button></div><div class="modal-grid"><div class="dash-card"><div class="card-title"><div><b>REGIONALI LOMBARDIA 2023</b><small>Preferenze per candidato · ${regionaliRows.length ? regionaliRows.length+' righe' : 'nessun dato'}</small></div></div>${renderRank(regionaliRows)}</div><div class="dash-card"><div class="card-title"><div><b>EUROPEE 2024</b><small>Preferenze per candidato · ${europeeRows.length ? europeeRows.length+' righe' : 'nessun dato'}</small></div></div>${renderRank(europeeRows)}</div></div></div></div>`;

 return Object.entries(out).sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1]);
}

function barChart(id,arr){

 let x=c.getContext('2d'),w=c.clientWidth||700,h=c.clientHeight||300;
 /* Renderizza a risoluzione superiore alla dimensione CSS: testo e numeri molto piu nitidi anche su monitor ad alta densita. */
 let d=Math.max(2,window.devicePixelRatio||1);

 const names={'MONZA E DELLA BRIANZA':'MONZA E BRIANZA'};
 let left=Math.min(225,Math.max(195,w*.32)),right=105,top=10,bottom=10;
 let rowH=Math.max(21,(h-top-bottom)/Math.max(rows.length,1));
 rows.forEach((a,i)=>{
   let y=top+i*rowH+rowH/2,barMax=Math.max(45,w-left-right),barW=barMax*(a[1]/max);
   let color=['#2b8cff','#22c88a','#8b5cf6','#f0a500'][i%4];
   x.textBaseline='middle';x.textAlign='right';x.font='600 13px Arial';x.fillStyle='#d7e5f2';

   x.fillStyle=color;x.fillRect(left,y-6,Math.max(4,barW),12);
   x.textAlign='left';x.font='700 13px Arial';x.fillStyle='#f2f7fb';
   x.fillText(a[1].toLocaleString('it-IT'),Math.min(left+barW+10,w-92),y);
 });
}

function effectiveCurrentTotals(rows){
 const groups={},used=new Set(),out={};
 rows.forEach(r=>{const tg=ticketForCandidate(r.candidato,r.prov); if(tg){if(!groups[tg.id])groups[tg.id]=[]; groups[tg.id].push(r);}});
 rows.forEach(r=>{const tg=ticketForCandidate(r.candidato,r.prov); if(tg){if(used.has(tg.id))return; used.add(tg.id); const rr=groups[tg.id]||[]; const byCand={}; rr.forEach(x=>byCand[x.candidato]=(byCand[x.candidato]||0)+(Number(x.preferenze)||0)); const winner=Object.entries(byCand).sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1])[0]; if(!winner)return; const cur=correnti[winner[0]]||'Da classificare'; out[cur]=(out[cur]||0)+winner[1];} else {const cur=correnti[r.candidato]||'Da classificare'; out[cur]=(out[cur]||0)+(Number(r.preferenze)||0);}});
 return Object.entries(out).sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1]);
}

function filterHTML(){let cm=[...new Set(data.filter(r=>!filters.prov||r.prov===filters.prov).map(r=>r.comune))].sort(),ca=[...CANDS],co=[...new Set(data.map(r=>r.corrente).filter(Boolean))].sort(),li=[...new Set(data.map(r=>r.lista))].sort();return opts('prov','Provincia',PROVS,filters.prov)+opts('comune','Comune',cm,filters.comune)+opts('candidato','Candidato',ca,filters.candidato)+opts('corrente','Corrente',co,filters.corrente)+opts('lista','Lista',li,filters.lista)+opts('camP','Camera P',CAM,filters.camP)+opts('senP','Senato P',SEN,filters.senP)+`<button class="btn bg2" onclick="clearF()">Azzera filtri</button>`}

function barChart(id,arr){
 let c=document.getElementById(id);if(!c)return;
 let x=c.getContext('2d'),w=c.clientWidth||700,h=c.clientHeight||300;
 /* Renderizza a risoluzione superiore alla dimensione CSS: testo e numeri molto piu nitidi anche su monitor ad alta densita. */
 let d=Math.max(2,window.devicePixelRatio||1);
 c.width=Math.round(w*d);c.height=Math.round(h*d);x.setTransform(d,0,0,d,0,0);x.clearRect(0,0,w,h);
 let rows=arr.slice().sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1]),max=Math.max(...rows.map(a=>a[1]),1);
 const names={'MONZA E DELLA BRIANZA':'MONZA E BRIANZA'};
 let left=Math.min(225,Math.max(195,w*.32)),right=105,top=10,bottom=10;
 let rowH=Math.max(21,(h-top-bottom)/Math.max(rows.length,1));
 rows.forEach((a,i)=>{
   let y=top+i*rowH+rowH/2,barMax=Math.max(45,w-left-right),barW=barMax*(a[1]/max);
   let color=['#2b8cff','#22c88a','#8b5cf6','#f0a500'][i%4];
   x.textBaseline='middle';x.textAlign='right';x.font='600 13px Arial';x.fillStyle='#d7e5f2';
   x.fillText(names[a[0]]||a[0],left-12,y);
   x.fillStyle='rgba(16,44,69,.9)';x.fillRect(left,y-6,barMax,12);
   x.fillStyle=color;x.fillRect(left,y-6,Math.max(4,barW),12);
   x.textAlign='left';x.font='700 13px Arial';x.fillStyle='#f2f7fb';
   x.fillText(a[1].toLocaleString('it-IT'),Math.min(left+barW+10,w-92),y);
 });
}

function filtered(){const fp=filters.prov?norm(filters.prov):'';return data.filter(r=>(!fp||norm(PROV_FULL[PROV_CODE[norm(r.prov)]||r.prov]||r.prov)===fp)&&(!filters.comune||norm(r.comune)===norm(filters.comune))&&(!filters.candidato||r.candidato===filters.candidato)&&(!filters.corrente||r.corrente===filters.corrente)&&(!filters.lista||r.lista===filters.lista)&&(!filters.camP||r.geo?.camP===filters.camP)&&(!filters.senP||r.geo?.senP===filters.senP))}
function filterHTML(){let cm=[...new Set(data.filter(r=>!filters.prov||r.prov===filters.prov).map(r=>r.comune))].sort(),ca=[...CANDS],co=[...new Set(data.map(r=>r.corrente).filter(Boolean))].sort(),li=[...new Set(data.map(r=>r.lista))].sort();return opts('prov','Provincia',PROVS,filters.prov)+opts('comune','Comune',cm,filters.comune)+opts('candidato','Candidato',ca,filters.candidato)+opts('corrente','Corrente',co,filters.corrente)+opts('lista','Lista',li,filters.lista)+opts('camP','Camera P',CAM,filters.camP)+opts('senP','Senato P',SEN,filters.senP)+`<button class="btn bg2" onclick="clearF()">Azzera filtri</button>`}
function agg(rows,key){let m={};rows.forEach(r=>{let k=key(r)||'Da classificare';m[k]=(m[k]||0)+r.preferenze});return Object.entries(m).sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1])}
function renderHome(){document.getElementById('k-pref').textContent=total().toLocaleString('it-IT');document.getElementById('k-comuni').textContent=new Set(GEO.map(g=>g.comune)).size.toLocaleString('it-IT');document.getElementById('k-candidati').textContent=CANDS.length;document.getElementById('k-correnti').textContent=new Set(Object.values(correnti).filter(Boolean)).size;document.getElementById('k-collegi').textContent=CAM.length+SEN.length;let p=agg(data,r=>r.prov),top=agg(data,r=>r.candidato).slice(0,8);document.getElementById('topCandidates').innerHTML=top.map((x,i)=>`<div class="rank-row"><b>${i+1}</b><div><strong>${esc(x[0])}</strong><small>${x[1].toLocaleString('it-IT')} preferenze</small></div><span>${(x[1]/total()*100).toFixed(1)}%</span></div>`).join('');document.getElementById('homeQuick').innerHTML=[['▦','TERRITORIO',GEO.length+' righe territoriali','Comune → collegio'],['♟','CANDIDATI',CANDS.length+' candidati','Corrente modificabile'],['⌖','COLLEGI',CAM.length+' Camera · '+SEN.length+' Senato','P + U'],['↔','CONFRONTO','Europee + Regionali','Pronto per il prossimo dataset']].map(x=>`<div class="quick-item"><span>${x[0]}</span><div><b>${x[1]}</b><small>${x[2]}</small><em>${x[3]}</em></div></div>`).join('');document.getElementById('correnteStatus').innerHTML=`<div class="status-list"><div><b>${CANDS.length}</b><span>candidati</span></div><div><b>${Object.values(correnti).filter(Boolean).length}</b><span>classificati</span></div><div><b>${CANDS.length-Object.values(correnti).filter(Boolean).length}</b><span>da classificare</span></div></div>`;barChart('provChart',p)}
function barChart(id,arr){
 let c=document.getElementById(id);if(!c)return;
 let x=c.getContext('2d'),w=c.clientWidth||700,h=c.clientHeight||300;
 /* Renderizza a risoluzione superiore alla dimensione CSS: testo e numeri molto piu nitidi anche su monitor ad alta densita. */
 let d=Math.max(2,window.devicePixelRatio||1);
 c.width=Math.round(w*d);c.height=Math.round(h*d);x.setTransform(d,0,0,d,0,0);x.clearRect(0,0,w,h);
 let rows=arr.slice().sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1]),max=Math.max(...rows.map(a=>a[1]),1);
 const names={'MONZA E DELLA BRIANZA':'MONZA E BRIANZA'};
 let left=Math.min(225,Math.max(195,w*.32)),right=105,top=10,bottom=10;
 let rowH=Math.max(21,(h-top-bottom)/Math.max(rows.length,1));
 rows.forEach((a,i)=>{
   let y=top+i*rowH+rowH/2,barMax=Math.max(45,w-left-right),barW=barMax*(a[1]/max);
   let color=['#2b8cff','#22c88a','#8b5cf6','#f0a500'][i%4];
   x.textBaseline='middle';x.textAlign='right';x.font='600 13px Arial';x.fillStyle='#d7e5f2';
   x.fillText(names[a[0]]||a[0],left-12,y);
   x.fillStyle='rgba(16,44,69,.9)';x.fillRect(left,y-6,barMax,12);
   x.fillStyle=color;x.fillRect(left,y-6,Math.max(4,barW),12);
   x.textAlign='left';x.font='700 13px Arial';x.fillStyle='#f2f7fb';
   x.fillText(a[1].toLocaleString('it-IT'),Math.min(left+barW+10,w-92),y);
 });
}

    const regionali=rr.map(r=>[r.candidato,Number(r.preferenze)||0]).filter(x=>x[0]).reduce((m,x)=>(m.set(x[0],(m.get(x[0])||0)+x[1]),m),new Map());
    const europee=ee.map(r=>[r.candidato,Number(r.preferenze)||0]).filter(x=>x[0]).reduce((m,x)=>(m.set(x[0],(m.get(x[0])||0)+x[1]),m),new Map());
    const regRank=[...regionali.entries()].sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1]);
    const eurRank=[...europee.entries()].sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1]);
    const g=GEO.find(x=>N(x.comune)===N(comune)&&same(x.prov,provincia)) || GEO.find(x=>N(x.comune)===N(comune));

function effectiveCurrentTotals(rows){

 return Object.entries(out).sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1]);
}

function barChart(id,arr){
 let c=document.getElementById(id);if(!c)return;
 let x=c.getContext('2d'),w=c.clientWidth||700,h=c.clientHeight||300;
 /* Renderizza a risoluzione superiore alla dimensione CSS: testo e numeri molto piu nitidi anche su monitor ad alta densita. */
 let d=Math.max(2,window.devicePixelRatio||1);
 c.width=Math.round(w*d);c.height=Math.round(h*d);x.setTransform(d,0,0,d,0,0);x.clearRect(0,0,w,h);
 let rows=arr.slice().sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1]),max=Math.max(...rows.map(a=>a[1]),1);
 const names={'MONZA E DELLA BRIANZA':'MONZA E BRIANZA'};
 let left=Math.min(225,Math.max(195,w*.32)),right=105,top=10,bottom=10;
 let rowH=Math.max(21,(h-top-bottom)/Math.max(rows.length,1));
 rows.forEach((a,i)=>{
   let y=top+i*rowH+rowH/2,barMax=Math.max(45,w-left-right),barW=barMax*(a[1]/max);
   let color=['#2b8cff','#22c88a','#8b5cf6','#f0a500'][i%4];
   x.textBaseline='middle';x.textAlign='right';x.font='600 13px Arial';x.fillStyle='#d7e5f2';
   x.fillText(names[a[0]]||a[0],left-12,y);
   x.fillStyle='rgba(16,44,69,.9)';x.fillRect(left,y-6,barMax,12);
   x.fillStyle=color;x.fillRect(left,y-6,Math.max(4,barW),12);
   x.textAlign='left';x.font='700 13px Arial';x.fillStyle='#f2f7fb';
   x.fillText(a[1].toLocaleString('it-IT'),Math.min(left+barW+10,w-92),y);
 });
}

function clearF(){filters={prov:'',comune:'',candidato:'',corrente:'',camP:'',senP:'',lista:''};render()}
function filtered(){const fp=filters.prov?norm(filters.prov):'';return data.filter(r=>(!fp||norm(PROV_FULL[PROV_CODE[norm(r.prov)]||r.prov]||r.prov)===fp)&&(!filters.comune||norm(r.comune)===norm(filters.comune))&&(!filters.candidato||r.candidato===filters.candidato)&&(!filters.corrente||r.corrente===filters.corrente)&&(!filters.lista||r.lista===filters.lista)&&(!filters.camP||r.geo?.camP===filters.camP)&&(!filters.senP||r.geo?.senP===filters.senP))}
function filterHTML(){let cm=[...new Set(data.filter(r=>!filters.prov||r.prov===filters.prov).map(r=>r.comune))].sort(),ca=[...CANDS],co=[...new Set(data.map(r=>r.corrente).filter(Boolean))].sort(),li=[...new Set(data.map(r=>r.lista))].sort();return opts('prov','Provincia',PROVS,filters.prov)+opts('comune','Comune',cm,filters.comune)+opts('candidato','Candidato',ca,filters.candidato)+opts('corrente','Corrente',co,filters.corrente)+opts('lista','Lista',li,filters.lista)+opts('camP','Camera P',CAM,filters.camP)+opts('senP','Senato P',SEN,filters.senP)+`<button class="btn bg2" onclick="clearF()">Azzera filtri</button>`}
function agg(rows,key){let m={};rows.forEach(r=>{let k=key(r)||'Da classificare';m[k]=(m[k]||0)+r.preferenze});return Object.entries(m).sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1])}
function renderHome(){document.getElementById('k-pref').textContent=total().toLocaleString('it-IT');document.getElementById('k-comuni').textContent=new Set(GEO.map(g=>g.comune)).size.toLocaleString('it-IT');document.getElementById('k-candidati').textContent=CANDS.length;document.getElementById('k-correnti').textContent=new Set(Object.values(correnti).filter(Boolean)).size;document.getElementById('k-collegi').textContent=CAM.length+SEN.length;let p=agg(data,r=>r.prov),top=agg(data,r=>r.candidato).slice(0,8);document.getElementById('topCandidates').innerHTML=top.map((x,i)=>`<div class="rank-row"><b>${i+1}</b><div><strong>${esc(x[0])}</strong><small>${x[1].toLocaleString('it-IT')} preferenze</small></div><span>${(x[1]/total()*100).toFixed(1)}%</span></div>`).join('');document.getElementById('homeQuick').innerHTML=[['▦','TERRITORIO',GEO.length+' righe territoriali','Comune → collegio'],['♟','CANDIDATI',CANDS.length+' candidati','Corrente modificabile'],['⌖','COLLEGI',CAM.length+' Camera · '+SEN.length+' Senato','P + U'],['↔','CONFRONTO','Europee + Regionali','Pronto per il prossimo dataset']].map(x=>`<div class="quick-item"><span>${x[0]}</span><div><b>${x[1]}</b><small>${x[2]}</small><em>${x[3]}</em></div></div>`).join('');document.getElementById('correnteStatus').innerHTML=`<div class="status-list"><div><b>${CANDS.length}</b><span>candidati</span></div><div><b>${Object.values(correnti).filter(Boolean).length}</b><span>classificati</span></div><div><b>${CANDS.length-Object.values(correnti).filter(Boolean).length}</b><span>da classificare</span></div></div>`;barChart('provChart',p)}
function barChart(id,arr){
 let c=document.getElementById(id);if(!c)return;
 let x=c.getContext('2d'),w=c.clientWidth||700,h=c.clientHeight||300;
 /* Renderizza a risoluzione superiore alla dimensione CSS: testo e numeri molto piu nitidi anche su monitor ad alta densita. */
 let d=Math.max(2,window.devicePixelRatio||1);
 c.width=Math.round(w*d);c.height=Math.round(h*d);x.setTransform(d,0,0,d,0,0);x.clearRect(0,0,w,h);
 let rows=arr.slice().sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1]),max=Math.max(...rows.map(a=>a[1]),1);
 const names={'MONZA E DELLA BRIANZA':'MONZA E BRIANZA'};
 let left=Math.min(225,Math.max(195,w*.32)),right=105,top=10,bottom=10;
 let rowH=Math.max(21,(h-top-bottom)/Math.max(rows.length,1));
 rows.forEach((a,i)=>{
   let y=top+i*rowH+rowH/2,barMax=Math.max(45,w-left-right),barW=barMax*(a[1]/max);
   let color=['#2b8cff','#22c88a','#8b5cf6','#f0a500'][i%4];
   x.textBaseline='middle';x.textAlign='right';x.font='600 13px Arial';x.fillStyle='#d7e5f2';
   x.fillText(names[a[0]]||a[0],left-12,y);
   x.fillStyle='rgba(16,44,69,.9)';x.fillRect(left,y-6,barMax,12);
   x.fillStyle=color;x.fillRect(left,y-6,Math.max(4,barW),12);
   x.textAlign='left';x.font='700 13px Arial';x.fillStyle='#f2f7fb';
   x.fillText(a[1].toLocaleString('it-IT'),Math.min(left+barW+10,w-92),y);
 });
}

function ticketForCandidate(c,prov){return ticketGroups.find(t=>t.prov===prov && t.candidates.includes(c));}
function effectiveCurrentTotals(rows){
 const groups={},used=new Set(),out={};
 rows.forEach(r=>{const tg=ticketForCandidate(r.candidato,r.prov); if(tg){if(!groups[tg.id])groups[tg.id]=[]; groups[tg.id].push(r);}});
 rows.forEach(r=>{const tg=ticketForCandidate(r.candidato,r.prov); if(tg){if(used.has(tg.id))return; used.add(tg.id); const rr=groups[tg.id]||[]; const byCand={}; rr.forEach(x=>byCand[x.candidato]=(byCand[x.candidato]||0)+(Number(x.preferenze)||0)); const winner=Object.entries(byCand).sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1])[0]; if(!winner)return; const cur=correnti[winner[0]]||'Da classificare'; out[cur]=(out[cur]||0)+winner[1];} else {const cur=correnti[r.candidato]||'Da classificare'; out[cur]=(out[cur]||0)+(Number(r.preferenze)||0);}});
 return Object.entries(out).sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1]);
}
function effectiveCurrentBy(rows,groupKey){
 const out={}; const groups={}; const used=new Set();
 rows.forEach(r=>{const g=groupKey(r)||'Da classificare'; const tg=ticketForCandidate(r.candidato,r.prov); if(tg){const k=g+'\u001f'+tg.id; if(!groups[k])groups[k]=[]; groups[k].push(r);} });
 rows.forEach(r=>{const g=groupKey(r)||'Da classificare'; const tg=ticketForCandidate(r.candidato,r.prov); if(tg){const k=g+'\u001f'+tg.id; if(used.has(k))return; used.add(k); const byCand={}; (groups[k]||[]).forEach(x=>byCand[x.candidato]=(byCand[x.candidato]||0)+(Number(x.preferenze)||0)); const winner=Object.entries(byCand).sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1])[0]; if(!winner)return; const cur=correnti[winner[0]]||'Da classificare'; if(!out[g])out[g]={}; out[g][cur]=(out[g][cur]||0)+winner[1];} else {const cur=correnti[r.candidato]||'Da classificare'; if(!out[g])out[g]={}; out[g][cur]=(out[g][cur]||0)+(Number(r.preferenze)||0);}});
 return out;
}

function effectiveCurrentTotals(rows){
 const groups={},used=new Set(),out={};
 rows.forEach(r=>{const tg=ticketForCandidate(r.candidato,r.prov); if(tg){if(!groups[tg.id])groups[tg.id]=[]; groups[tg.id].push(r);}});
 rows.forEach(r=>{const tg=ticketForCandidate(r.candidato,r.prov); if(tg){if(used.has(tg.id))return; used.add(tg.id); const rr=groups[tg.id]||[]; const byCand={}; rr.forEach(x=>byCand[x.candidato]=(byCand[x.candidato]||0)+(Number(x.preferenze)||0)); const winner=Object.entries(byCand).sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1])[0]; if(!winner)return; const cur=correnti[winner[0]]||'Da classificare'; out[cur]=(out[cur]||0)+winner[1];} else {const cur=correnti[r.candidato]||'Da classificare'; out[cur]=(out[cur]||0)+(Number(r.preferenze)||0);}});
 return Object.entries(out).sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1]);
}

function barChart(id,arr){
 let c=document.getElementById(id);if(!c)return;
 let x=c.getContext('2d'),w=c.clientWidth||700,h=c.clientHeight||300;
 /* Renderizza a risoluzione superiore alla dimensione CSS: testo e numeri molto piu nitidi anche su monitor ad alta densita. */
 let d=Math.max(2,window.devicePixelRatio||1);
 c.width=Math.round(w*d);c.height=Math.round(h*d);x.setTransform(d,0,0,d,0,0);x.clearRect(0,0,w,h);
 let rows=arr.slice().sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1]),max=Math.max(...rows.map(a=>a[1]),1);
 const names={'MONZA E DELLA BRIANZA':'MONZA E BRIANZA'};
 let left=Math.min(225,Math.max(195,w*.32)),right=105,top=10,bottom=10;
 let rowH=Math.max(21,(h-top-bottom)/Math.max(rows.length,1));
 rows.forEach((a,i)=>{
   let y=top+i*rowH+rowH/2,barMax=Math.max(45,w-left-right),barW=barMax*(a[1]/max);
   let color=['#2b8cff','#22c88a','#8b5cf6','#f0a500'][i%4];
   x.textBaseline='middle';x.textAlign='right';x.font='600 13px Arial';x.fillStyle='#d7e5f2';
   x.fillText(names[a[0]]||a[0],left-12,y);
   x.fillStyle='rgba(16,44,69,.9)';x.fillRect(left,y-6,barMax,12);
   x.fillStyle=color;x.fillRect(left,y-6,Math.max(4,barW),12);
   x.textAlign='left';x.font='700 13px Arial';x.fillStyle='#f2f7fb';
   x.fillText(a[1].toLocaleString('it-IT'),Math.min(left+barW+10,w-92),y);
 });
}

function barChart(id,arr){
 let c=document.getElementById(id);if(!c)return;
 let x=c.getContext('2d'),w=c.clientWidth||700,h=c.clientHeight||300;
 /* Renderizza a risoluzione superiore alla dimensione CSS: testo e numeri molto piu nitidi anche su monitor ad alta densita. */
 let d=Math.max(2,window.devicePixelRatio||1);
 c.width=Math.round(w*d);c.height=Math.round(h*d);x.setTransform(d,0,0,d,0,0);x.clearRect(0,0,w,h);
 let rows=arr.slice().sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1]),max=Math.max(...rows.map(a=>a[1]),1);
 const names={'MONZA E DELLA BRIANZA':'MONZA E BRIANZA'};
 let left=Math.min(225,Math.max(195,w*.32)),right=105,top=10,bottom=10;
 let rowH=Math.max(21,(h-top-bottom)/Math.max(rows.length,1));
 rows.forEach((a,i)=>{
   let y=top+i*rowH+rowH/2,barMax=Math.max(45,w-left-right),barW=barMax*(a[1]/max);
   let color=['#2b8cff','#22c88a','#8b5cf6','#f0a500'][i%4];
   x.textBaseline='middle';x.textAlign='right';x.font='600 13px Arial';x.fillStyle='#d7e5f2';
   x.fillText(names[a[0]]||a[0],left-12,y);
   x.fillStyle='rgba(16,44,69,.9)';x.fillRect(left,y-6,barMax,12);
   x.fillStyle=color;x.fillRect(left,y-6,Math.max(4,barW),12);
   x.textAlign='left';x.font='700 13px Arial';x.fillStyle='#f2f7fb';
   x.fillText(a[1].toLocaleString('it-IT'),Math.min(left+barW+10,w-92),y);
 });
}

}

 let left=Math.min(225,Math.max(195,w*.32)),right=105,top=10,bottom=10;
 let rowH=Math.max(21,(h-top-bottom)/Math.max(rows.length,1));
 rows.forEach((a,i)=>{
   let y=top+i*rowH+rowH/2,barMax=Math.max(45,w-left-right),barW=barMax*(a[1]/max);
   let color=['#2b8cff','#22c88a','#8b5cf6','#f0a500'][i%4];
   x.textBaseline='middle';x.textAlign='right';x.font='600 13px Arial';x.fillStyle='#d7e5f2';
   x.fillText(names[a[0]]||a[0],left-12,y);
   x.fillStyle='rgba(16,44,69,.9)';x.fillRect(left,y-6,barMax,12);
   x.fillStyle=color;x.fillRect(left,y-6,Math.max(4,barW),12);
   x.textAlign='left';x.font='700 13px Arial';x.fillStyle='#f2f7fb';
   x.fillText(a[1].toLocaleString('it-IT'),Math.min(left+barW+10,w-92),y);
 });
}

function barChart(id,arr){

 let x=c.getContext('2d'),w=c.clientWidth||700,h=c.clientHeight||300;
 /* Renderizza a risoluzione superiore alla dimensione CSS: testo e numeri molto piu nitidi anche su monitor ad alta densita. */
 let d=Math.max(2,window.devicePixelRatio||1);
 c.width=Math.round(w*d);c.height=Math.round(h*d);x.setTransform(d,0,0,d,0,0);x.clearRect(0,0,w,h);

 let rowH=Math.max(21,(h-top-bottom)/Math.max(rows.length,1));
 rows.forEach((a,i)=>{
   let y=top+i*rowH+rowH/2,barMax=Math.max(45,w-left-right),barW=barMax*(a[1]/max);
   let color=['#2b8cff','#22c88a','#8b5cf6','#f0a500'][i%4];
   x.textBaseline='middle';x.textAlign='right';x.font='600 13px Arial';x.fillStyle='#d7e5f2';

   x.fillStyle=color;x.fillRect(left,y-6,Math.max(4,barW),12);
   x.textAlign='left';x.font='700 13px Arial';x.fillStyle='#f2f7fb';
   x.fillText(a[1].toLocaleString('it-IT'),Math.min(left+barW+10,w-92),y);
 });
}

function barChart(id,arr){
 let c=document.getElementById(id);if(!c)return;
 let x=c.getContext('2d'),w=c.clientWidth||700,h=c.clientHeight||300;
 /* Renderizza a risoluzione superiore alla dimensione CSS: testo e numeri molto piu nitidi anche su monitor ad alta densita. */
 let d=Math.max(2,window.devicePixelRatio||1);
 c.width=Math.round(w*d);c.height=Math.round(h*d);x.setTransform(d,0,0,d,0,0);x.clearRect(0,0,w,h);
 let rows=arr.slice().sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1]),max=Math.max(...rows.map(a=>a[1]),1);
 const names={'MONZA E DELLA BRIANZA':'MONZA E BRIANZA'};
 let left=Math.min(225,Math.max(195,w*.32)),right=105,top=10,bottom=10;
 let rowH=Math.max(21,(h-top-bottom)/Math.max(rows.length,1));
 rows.forEach((a,i)=>{
   let y=top+i*rowH+rowH/2,barMax=Math.max(45,w-left-right),barW=barMax*(a[1]/max);
   let color=['#2b8cff','#22c88a','#8b5cf6','#f0a500'][i%4];
   x.textBaseline='middle';x.textAlign='right';x.font='600 13px Arial';x.fillStyle='#d7e5f2';
   x.fillText(names[a[0]]||a[0],left-12,y);
   x.fillStyle='rgba(16,44,69,.9)';x.fillRect(left,y-6,barMax,12);
   x.fillStyle=color;x.fillRect(left,y-6,Math.max(4,barW),12);
   x.textAlign='left';x.font='700 13px Arial';x.fillStyle='#f2f7fb';
   x.fillText(a[1].toLocaleString('it-IT'),Math.min(left+barW+10,w-92),y);
 });
}

function barChart(id,arr){
 let c=document.getElementById(id);if(!c)return;
 let x=c.getContext('2d'),w=c.clientWidth||700,h=c.clientHeight||300;
 /* Renderizza a risoluzione superiore alla dimensione CSS: testo e numeri molto piu nitidi anche su monitor ad alta densita. */
 let d=Math.max(2,window.devicePixelRatio||1);
 c.width=Math.round(w*d);c.height=Math.round(h*d);x.setTransform(d,0,0,d,0,0);x.clearRect(0,0,w,h);
 let rows=arr.slice().sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1]),max=Math.max(...rows.map(a=>a[1]),1);
 const names={'MONZA E DELLA BRIANZA':'MONZA E BRIANZA'};
 let left=Math.min(225,Math.max(195,w*.32)),right=105,top=10,bottom=10;
 let rowH=Math.max(21,(h-top-bottom)/Math.max(rows.length,1));
 rows.forEach((a,i)=>{
   let y=top+i*rowH+rowH/2,barMax=Math.max(45,w-left-right),barW=barMax*(a[1]/max);
   let color=['#2b8cff','#22c88a','#8b5cf6','#f0a500'][i%4];
   x.textBaseline='middle';x.textAlign='right';x.font='600 13px Arial';x.fillStyle='#d7e5f2';
   x.fillText(names[a[0]]||a[0],left-12,y);
   x.fillStyle='rgba(16,44,69,.9)';x.fillRect(left,y-6,barMax,12);
   x.fillStyle=color;x.fillRect(left,y-6,Math.max(4,barW),12);
   x.textAlign='left';x.font='700 13px Arial';x.fillStyle='#f2f7fb';
   x.fillText(a[1].toLocaleString('it-IT'),Math.min(left+barW+10,w-92),y);
 });
}

 return Object.entries(out).sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1]);
}

 let d=Math.max(2,window.devicePixelRatio||1);
 c.width=Math.round(w*d);c.height=Math.round(h*d);x.setTransform(d,0,0,d,0,0);x.clearRect(0,0,w,h);
 let rows=arr.slice().sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1]),max=Math.max(...rows.map(a=>a[1]),1);
 const names={'MONZA E DELLA BRIANZA':'MONZA E BRIANZA'};
 let left=Math.min(225,Math.max(195,w*.32)),right=105,top=10,bottom=10;
 let rowH=Math.max(21,(h-top-bottom)/Math.max(rows.length,1));
 rows.forEach((a,i)=>{
   let y=top+i*rowH+rowH/2,barMax=Math.max(45,w-left-right),barW=barMax*(a[1]/max);
   let color=['#2b8cff','#22c88a','#8b5cf6','#f0a500'][i%4];
   x.textBaseline='middle';x.textAlign='right';x.font='600 13px Arial';x.fillStyle='#d7e5f2';
   x.fillText(names[a[0]]||a[0],left-12,y);
   x.fillStyle='rgba(16,44,69,.9)';x.fillRect(left,y-6,barMax,12);
   x.fillStyle=color;x.fillRect(left,y-6,Math.max(4,barW),12);
   x.textAlign='left';x.font='700 13px Arial';x.fillStyle='#f2f7fb';
   x.fillText(a[1].toLocaleString('it-IT'),Math.min(left+barW+10,w-92),y);
 });
}
function renderPref(){
  document.getElementById('prefFilters').innerHTML=filterHTML();
  const rows=filtered();
  const totals=agg(rows,r=>r.candidato);
  document.getElementById('prefTable').innerHTML=totals.map((x,i)=>{
    const c=x[0], corrente=correnti[c]||'—';
    return `<tr class="candidate-total-row"><td>${i+1}</td><td><button class="link-btn candidate-total" onclick="openCandidate(${JSON.stringify(c)})">${esc(c)}</button></td><td><div style="display:flex;gap:6px"><input class="inline-input" value="${esc(corrente==='—'?'':corrente)}" placeholder="Inserisci corrente" onchange="saveCorrente(${JSON.stringify(c)},this.value)"><button class="btn bg2" onclick="saveCorrente(${JSON.stringify(c)},this.previousElementSibling.value)">Salva</button></div></td><td><b>${x[1].toLocaleString('it-IT')}</b></td></tr>`;
  }).join('') || `<tr><td colspan="4"><div class="empty-state"><b>Nessun dato</b><span>Modifica i filtri selezionati.</span></div></td></tr>`;
