function openCandidate(candidate){
  const rows=data.filter(r=>r.candidato===candidate && (!filters.prov||r.prov===filters.prov) && (!filters.comune||r.comune===filters.comune) && (!filters.lista||r.lista===filters.lista) && (!filters.corrente||r.corrente===filters.corrente));
  const byComune=agg(rows,r=>r.comune);
  const total=byComune.reduce((s,x)=>s+x[1],0);
  const scope=filters.prov?filters.prov:'Tutta la Lombardia';
  const html=`<div class="modal-backdrop candidate-list-modal" onclick="if(event.target===this)closeCandidate()"><div class="modal-card"><div class="modal-head"><div><div class="eyebrow">SCHEDA CANDIDATO · ${esc(electionLabel())}</div><h2>${esc(candidate)}</h2><p>${esc(scope)} · ${total.toLocaleString('it-IT')} preferenze</p></div><button class="btn bg2" onclick="closeCandidate()">Chiudi ✕</button></div><div class="dash-card"><div class="card-title"><div><b>Comuni e preferenze</b><small>Ordinati dal Comune con più preferenze</small></div></div><div class="table-wrap"><table class="data-table"><thead><tr><th>#</th><th>Comune</th><th>Preferenze</th></tr></thead><tbody>${byComune.map((x,i)=>`<tr><td>${i+1}</td><td><button class="link-btn" onclick="closeCandidate();openComune(${esc(JSON.stringify(x[0]))},${JSON.stringify(rows.find(r=>r.comune===x[0])?.prov||'')})"><b>${esc(x[0])}</b></button></td><td><b>${x[1].toLocaleString('it-IT')}</b></td></tr>`).join('')}</tbody><tfoot><tr class="total-row"><td></td><td>TOTALE</td><td>${total.toLocaleString('it-IT')}</td></tr></tfoot></table></div></div></div></div>`;
  document.body.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend',html);
}

function addTicketInline(){const prov=document.getElementById('tkProv')?.value||'',a=(document.getElementById('tkA')?.value||'').trim(),b=(document.getElementById('tkB')?.value||'').trim();if(!prov||!a||!b){alert('Compila Provincia, Candidato 1 e Candidato 2.');return;}const ca=CANDS.find(c=>norm(c)===norm(a)),cb=CANDS.find(c=>norm(c)===norm(b));if(!ca||!cb){alert('I due candidati devono essere selezionati dall’elenco dei candidati.');return;}if(ca===cb){alert('Seleziona due candidati diversi.');return;}if(ticketGroups.some(t=>t.prov===prov&&t.candidates.length===2&&t.candidates.includes(ca)&&t.candidates.includes(cb))){alert('Questo ticket esiste già.');return;}ticketGroups.push({id:'T'+Date.now(),prov,candidates:[ca,cb]});saveTickets();renderCand();}

function barChart(id,arr){
 let c=document.getElementById(id);if(!c)return;
 let x=c.getContext('2d'),w=c.clientWidth||700,h=c.clientHeight||300;
 /* Renderizza a risoluzione superiore alla dimensione CSS: testo e numeri molto piu nitidi anche su monitor ad alta densita. */
 let d=Math.max(2,window.devicePixelRatio||1);
 c.width=Math.round(w*d);c.height=Math.round(h*d);x.setTransform(d,0,0,d,0,0);x.clearRect(0,0,w,h);
 let rows=arr.slice().sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1]),max=Math.max(...rows.map(a=>a[1]),1);
 const names={'MONZA E DELLA BRIANZA':'MONZA E BRIANZA'};
 let left=Math.min(225,Math.max(195,w*.32)),right=105,top=10,bottom=10;
 let rowH=Math.max(21,(h-top-bottom)/Math.max(rows.length,1));
 rows.forEach((a,i)=>{
   let y=top+i*rowH+rowH/2,barMax=Math.max(45,w-left-right),barW=barMax*(a[1]/max);
   let color=['#2b8cff','#22c88a','#8b5cf6','#f0a500'][i%4];
   x.textBaseline='middle';x.textAlign='right';x.font='600 13px Arial';x.fillStyle='#d7e5f2';
   x.fillText(names[a[0]]||a[0],left-12,y);
   x.fillStyle='rgba(16,44,69,.9)';x.fillRect(left,y-6,barMax,12);
   x.fillStyle=color;x.fillRect(left,y-6,Math.max(4,barW),12);
   x.textAlign='left';x.font='700 13px Arial';x.fillStyle='#f2f7fb';
   x.fillText(a[1].toLocaleString('it-IT'),Math.min(left+barW+10,w-92),y);
 });
}

function barChart(id,arr){
 let c=document.getElementById(id);if(!c)return;
 let x=c.getContext('2d'),w=c.clientWidth||700,h=c.clientHeight||300;
 /* Renderizza a risoluzione superiore alla dimensione CSS: testo e numeri molto piu nitidi anche su monitor ad alta densita. */
 let d=Math.max(2,window.devicePixelRatio||1);
 c.width=Math.round(w*d);c.height=Math.round(h*d);x.setTransform(d,0,0,d,0,0);x.clearRect(0,0,w,h);
 let rows=arr.slice().sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1]),max=Math.max(...rows.map(a=>a[1]),1);
 const names={'MONZA E DELLA BRIANZA':'MONZA E BRIANZA'};
 let left=Math.min(225,Math.max(195,w*.32)),right=105,top=10,bottom=10;
 let rowH=Math.max(21,(h-top-bottom)/Math.max(rows.length,1));
 rows.forEach((a,i)=>{
   let y=top+i*rowH+rowH/2,barMax=Math.max(45,w-left-right),barW=barMax*(a[1]/max);
   let color=['#2b8cff','#22c88a','#8b5cf6','#f0a500'][i%4];
   x.textBaseline='middle';x.textAlign='right';x.font='600 13px Arial';x.fillStyle='#d7e5f2';
   x.fillText(names[a[0]]||a[0],left-12,y);
   x.fillStyle='rgba(16,44,69,.9)';x.fillRect(left,y-6,barMax,12);
   x.fillStyle=color;x.fillRect(left,y-6,Math.max(4,barW),12);
   x.textAlign='left';x.font='700 13px Arial';x.fillStyle='#f2f7fb';
   x.fillText(a[1].toLocaleString('it-IT'),Math.min(left+barW+10,w-92),y);
 });
}

    return `<tr class="candidate-total-row"><td>${i+1}</td><td><button class="link-btn candidate-total" onclick="openCandidate(${JSON.stringify(c)})">${esc(c)}</button></td><td><div style="display:flex;gap:6px"><input class="inline-input" value="${esc(corrente==='—'?'':corrente)}" placeholder="Inserisci corrente" onchange="saveCorrente(${JSON.stringify(c)},this.value)"><button class="btn bg2" onclick="saveCorrente(${JSON.stringify(c)},this.previousElementSibling.value)">Salva</button></div></td><td><b>${x[1].toLocaleString('it-IT')}</b></td></tr>`;
  }).join('') || `<tr><td colspan="4"><div class="empty-state"><b>Nessun dato</b><span>Modifica i filtri selezionati.</span></div></td></tr>`;
}
function openCandidate(candidate){
  const rows=data.filter(r=>r.candidato===candidate && (!filters.prov||r.prov===filters.prov) && (!filters.comune||r.comune===filters.comune) && (!filters.lista||r.lista===filters.lista) && (!filters.corrente||r.corrente===filters.corrente));
  const byComune=agg(rows,r=>r.comune);
  const total=byComune.reduce((s,x)=>s+x[1],0);
  const scope=filters.prov?filters.prov:'Tutta la Lombardia';
  const html=`<div class="modal-backdrop candidate-list-modal" onclick="if(event.target===this)closeCandidate()"><div class="modal-card"><div class="modal-head"><div><div class="eyebrow">SCHEDA CANDIDATO · ${esc(electionLabel())}</div><h2>${esc(candidate)}</h2><p>${esc(scope)} · ${total.toLocaleString('it-IT')} preferenze</p></div><button class="btn bg2" onclick="closeCandidate()">Chiudi ✕</button></div><div class="dash-card"><div class="card-title"><div><b>Comuni e preferenze</b><small>Ordinati dal Comune con più preferenze</small></div></div><div class="table-wrap"><table class="data-table"><thead><tr><th>#</th><th>Comune</th><th>Preferenze</th></tr></thead><tbody>${byComune.map((x,i)=>`<tr><td>${i+1}</td><td><button class="link-btn" onclick="closeCandidate();openComune(${esc(JSON.stringify(x[0]))},${JSON.stringify(rows.find(r=>r.comune===x[0])?.prov||'')})"><b>${esc(x[0])}</b></button></td><td><b>${x[1].toLocaleString('it-IT')}</b></td></tr>`).join('')}</tbody><tfoot><tr class="total-row"><td></td><td>TOTALE</td><td>${total.toLocaleString('it-IT')}</td></tr></tfoot></table></div></div></div></div>`;
  document.body.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend',html);
}

function barChart(id,arr){
 let c=document.getElementById(id);if(!c)return;
 let x=c.getContext('2d'),w=c.clientWidth||700,h=c.clientHeight||300;
 /* Renderizza a risoluzione superiore alla dimensione CSS: testo e numeri molto piu nitidi anche su monitor ad alta densita. */
 let d=Math.max(2,window.devicePixelRatio||1);
 c.width=Math.round(w*d);c.height=Math.round(h*d);x.setTransform(d,0,0,d,0,0);x.clearRect(0,0,w,h);
 let rows=arr.slice().sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1]),max=Math.max(...rows.map(a=>a[1]),1);
 const names={'MONZA E DELLA BRIANZA':'MONZA E BRIANZA'};
 let left=Math.min(225,Math.max(195,w*.32)),right=105,top=10,bottom=10;
 let rowH=Math.max(21,(h-top-bottom)/Math.max(rows.length,1));
 rows.forEach((a,i)=>{
   let y=top+i*rowH+rowH/2,barMax=Math.max(45,w-left-right),barW=barMax*(a[1]/max);
   let color=['#2b8cff','#22c88a','#8b5cf6','#f0a500'][i%4];
   x.textBaseline='middle';x.textAlign='right';x.font='600 13px Arial';x.fillStyle='#d7e5f2';
   x.fillText(names[a[0]]||a[0],left-12,y);
   x.fillStyle='rgba(16,44,69,.9)';x.fillRect(left,y-6,barMax,12);
   x.fillStyle=color;x.fillRect(left,y-6,Math.max(4,barW),12);
   x.textAlign='left';x.font='700 13px Arial';x.fillStyle='#f2f7fb';
   x.fillText(a[1].toLocaleString('it-IT'),Math.min(left+barW+10,w-92),y);
 });
}

function barChart(id,arr){
 let c=document.getElementById(id);if(!c)return;
 let x=c.getContext('2d'),w=c.clientWidth||700,h=c.clientHeight||300;
 /* Renderizza a risoluzione superiore alla dimensione CSS: testo e numeri molto piu nitidi anche su monitor ad alta densita. */
 let d=Math.max(2,window.devicePixelRatio||1);
 c.width=Math.round(w*d);c.height=Math.round(h*d);x.setTransform(d,0,0,d,0,0);x.clearRect(0,0,w,h);
 let rows=arr.slice().sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1]),max=Math.max(...rows.map(a=>a[1]),1);
 const names={'MONZA E DELLA BRIANZA':'MONZA E BRIANZA'};
 let left=Math.min(225,Math.max(195,w*.32)),right=105,top=10,bottom=10;
 let rowH=Math.max(21,(h-top-bottom)/Math.max(rows.length,1));
 rows.forEach((a,i)=>{
   let y=top+i*rowH+rowH/2,barMax=Math.max(45,w-left-right),barW=barMax*(a[1]/max);
   let color=['#2b8cff','#22c88a','#8b5cf6','#f0a500'][i%4];
   x.textBaseline='middle';x.textAlign='right';x.font='600 13px Arial';x.fillStyle='#d7e5f2';
   x.fillText(names[a[0]]||a[0],left-12,y);
   x.fillStyle='rgba(16,44,69,.9)';x.fillRect(left,y-6,barMax,12);
   x.fillStyle=color;x.fillRect(left,y-6,Math.max(4,barW),12);
   x.textAlign='left';x.font='700 13px Arial';x.fillStyle='#f2f7fb';
   x.fillText(a[1].toLocaleString('it-IT'),Math.min(left+barW+10,w-92),y);
 });
}

function openCandidate(candidate){
  const rows=data.filter(r=>r.candidato===candidate && (!filters.prov||r.prov===filters.prov) && (!filters.comune||r.comune===filters.comune) && (!filters.lista||r.lista===filters.lista) && (!filters.corrente||r.corrente===filters.corrente));
  const byComune=agg(rows,r=>r.comune);
  const total=byComune.reduce((s,x)=>s+x[1],0);
  const scope=filters.prov?filters.prov:'Tutta la Lombardia';
  const html=`<div class="modal-backdrop candidate-list-modal" onclick="if(event.target===this)closeCandidate()"><div class="modal-card"><div class="modal-head"><div><div class="eyebrow">SCHEDA CANDIDATO · ${esc(electionLabel())}</div><h2>${esc(candidate)}</h2><p>${esc(scope)} · ${total.toLocaleString('it-IT')} preferenze</p></div><button class="btn bg2" onclick="closeCandidate()">Chiudi ✕</button></div><div class="dash-card"><div class="card-title"><div><b>Comuni e preferenze</b><small>Ordinati dal Comune con più preferenze</small></div></div><div class="table-wrap"><table class="data-table"><thead><tr><th>#</th><th>Comune</th><th>Preferenze</th></tr></thead><tbody>${byComune.map((x,i)=>`<tr><td>${i+1}</td><td><button class="link-btn" onclick="closeCandidate();openComune(${esc(JSON.stringify(x[0]))},${JSON.stringify(rows.find(r=>r.comune===x[0])?.prov||'')})"><b>${esc(x[0])}</b></button></td><td><b>${x[1].toLocaleString('it-IT')}</b></td></tr>`).join('')}</tbody><tfoot><tr class="total-row"><td></td><td>TOTALE</td><td>${total.toLocaleString('it-IT')}</td></tr></tfoot></table></div></div></div></div>`;
  document.body.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend',html);
}

function addTicketInline(){const prov=document.getElementById('tkProv')?.value||'',a=(document.getElementById('tkA')?.value||'').trim(),b=(document.getElementById('tkB')?.value||'').trim();if(!prov||!a||!b){alert('Compila Provincia, Candidato 1 e Candidato 2.');return;}const ca=CANDS.find(c=>norm(c)===norm(a)),cb=CANDS.find(c=>norm(c)===norm(b));if(!ca||!cb){alert('I due candidati devono essere selezionati dall’elenco dei candidati.');return;}if(ca===cb){alert('Seleziona due candidati diversi.');return;}if(ticketGroups.some(t=>t.prov===prov&&t.candidates.length===2&&t.candidates.includes(ca)&&t.candidates.includes(cb))){alert('Questo ticket esiste già.');return;}ticketGroups.push({id:'T'+Date.now(),prov,candidates:[ca,cb]});saveTickets();renderCand();}

function openCandidate(candidate){
  const rows=data.filter(r=>r.candidato===candidate && (!filters.prov||r.prov===filters.prov) && (!filters.comune||r.comune===filters.comune) && (!filters.lista||r.lista===filters.lista) && (!filters.corrente||r.corrente===filters.corrente));
  const byComune=agg(rows,r=>r.comune);
  const total=byComune.reduce((s,x)=>s+x[1],0);
  const scope=filters.prov?filters.prov:'Tutta la Lombardia';
  const html=`<div class="modal-backdrop candidate-list-modal" onclick="if(event.target===this)closeCandidate()"><div class="modal-card"><div class="modal-head"><div><div class="eyebrow">SCHEDA CANDIDATO · ${esc(electionLabel())}</div><h2>${esc(candidate)}</h2><p>${esc(scope)} · ${total.toLocaleString('it-IT')} preferenze</p></div><button class="btn bg2" onclick="closeCandidate()">Chiudi ✕</button></div><div class="dash-card"><div class="card-title"><div><b>Comuni e preferenze</b><small>Ordinati dal Comune con più preferenze</small></div></div><div class="table-wrap"><table class="data-table"><thead><tr><th>#</th><th>Comune</th><th>Preferenze</th></tr></thead><tbody>${byComune.map((x,i)=>`<tr><td>${i+1}</td><td><button class="link-btn" onclick="closeCandidate();openComune(${esc(JSON.stringify(x[0]))},${JSON.stringify(rows.find(r=>r.comune===x[0])?.prov||'')})"><b>${esc(x[0])}</b></button></td><td><b>${x[1].toLocaleString('it-IT')}</b></td></tr>`).join('')}</tbody><tfoot><tr class="total-row"><td></td><td>TOTALE</td><td>${total.toLocaleString('it-IT')}</td></tr></tfoot></table></div></div></div></div>`;
  document.body.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend',html);
}

function openCandidate(candidate){
  const rows=data.filter(r=>r.candidato===candidate && (!filters.prov||r.prov===filters.prov) && (!filters.comune||r.comune===filters.comune) && (!filters.lista||r.lista===filters.lista) && (!filters.corrente||r.corrente===filters.corrente));
  const byComune=agg(rows,r=>r.comune);
  const total=byComune.reduce((s,x)=>s+x[1],0);
  const scope=filters.prov?filters.prov:'Tutta la Lombardia';

function renderCand(){
 const body=CANDS.map(c=>{let rs=data.filter(r=>r.candidato===c),x=rs[0],t=rs.reduce((s,r)=>s+r.preferenze,0);let provs=[...new Set(rs.map(r=>r.prov))];let tickets=provs.map(p=>ticketForCandidate(c,p)).filter(Boolean);let ticketLabel=tickets.length?tickets.map(t=>t.candidates.filter(n=>n!==c).join(' + ')).join(' · '):'—';return `<tr><td><b>${esc(c)}</b></td><td>${esc(x.lista)}</td><td>${esc(x.data)}</td><td>${esc(x.luogo)}</td><td>${t.toLocaleString('it-IT')}</td><td><div style="display:flex;gap:6px"><input class="inline-input" value="${esc(correnti[c]||'')}" placeholder="Inserisci corrente" onchange="saveCorrente(${JSON.stringify(c)},this.value)"><button class="btn bg2" onclick="saveCorrente(${JSON.stringify(c)},this.previousElementSibling.value)">Salva</button></div></td><td>${esc(ticketLabel)}</td></tr>`}).join('');

 const tickets=ticketGroups.map(t=>`<tr><td>${esc(PROV_FULL[PROV_CODE[norm(t.prov)]]||t.prov)}</td><td><b>${t.candidates.map(esc).join(' + ')}</b></td><td>${ticketValue(t).toLocaleString('it-IT')}</td><td><button class="btn bg2" data-ticket-id="${esc(t.id)}">Elimina</button></td></tr>`).join('')||'<tr><td colspan="4" class="muted">Nessun ticket inserito.</td></tr>';
 document.getElementById('candTable').innerHTML=body;
 const host=document.getElementById('candTable').closest('.table-wrap')?.parentElement || document.getElementById('candTable').parentElement;
 const old=document.getElementById('ticketManagerInline'); if(old)old.remove();
 const panel=`<div id="ticketManagerInline" class="dash-card" style="margin-top:16px"><div class="card-title"><div><b>GESTIONE TICKET</b><small>Il ticket non somma i voti: nell'analisi della corrente viene conteggiato una sola volta il candidato con più preferenze.</small></div></div><div class="filter-bar" style="align-items:end"><label class="filter-control"><span>Provincia</span><select id="tkProv">${provs}</select></label><label class="filter-control" style="min-width:260px"><span>Candidato 1</span><input id="tkA" class="inline-input" style="width:100%" list="ticketCandidates" placeholder="Scrivi il nome del candidato"></label><label class="filter-control" style="min-width:260px"><span>Candidato 2</span><input id="tkB" class="inline-input" style="width:100%" list="ticketCandidates" placeholder="Scrivi il nome del candidato"></label><button class="btn" type="button" onclick="addTicketInline()">+ AGGIUNGI TICKET</button></div><datalist id="ticketCandidates">${opts}</datalist><div class="table-wrap" style="margin-top:14px"><table class="data-table"><thead><tr><th>Provincia</th><th>Ticket</th><th>Valore conteggiato</th><th></th></tr></thead><tbody>${tickets}</tbody></table></div></div>`;

function groupRows(rows,key){let m={};rows.forEach(r=>{let k=key(r)||'Da classificare';m[k]=(m[k]||0)+(Number(r.preferenze)||0)});return Object.entries(m).sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1])}

function renderPref(){
  document.getElementById('prefFilters').innerHTML=filterHTML();
  const rows=filtered();
  const totals=agg(rows,r=>r.candidato);
  document.getElementById('prefTable').innerHTML=totals.map((x,i)=>{
    const c=x[0], corrente=correnti[c]||'—';
    return `<tr class="candidate-total-row"><td>${i+1}</td><td><button class="link-btn candidate-total" onclick="openCandidate(${JSON.stringify(c)})">${esc(c)}</button></td><td><div style="display:flex;gap:6px"><input class="inline-input" value="${esc(corrente==='—'?'':corrente)}" placeholder="Inserisci corrente" onchange="saveCorrente(${JSON.stringify(c)},this.value)"><button class="btn bg2" onclick="saveCorrente(${JSON.stringify(c)},this.previousElementSibling.value)">Salva</button></div></td><td><b>${x[1].toLocaleString('it-IT')}</b></td></tr>`;
  }).join('') || `<tr><td colspan="4"><div class="empty-state"><b>Nessun dato</b><span>Modifica i filtri selezionati.</span></div></td></tr>`;
}
function openCandidate(candidate){
  const rows=data.filter(r=>r.candidato===candidate && (!filters.prov||r.prov===filters.prov) && (!filters.comune||r.comune===filters.comune) && (!filters.lista||r.lista===filters.lista) && (!filters.corrente||r.corrente===filters.corrente));
  const byComune=agg(rows,r=>r.comune);
  const total=byComune.reduce((s,x)=>s+x[1],0);
  const scope=filters.prov?filters.prov:'Tutta la Lombardia';
  const html=`<div class="modal-backdrop candidate-list-modal" onclick="if(event.target===this)closeCandidate()"><div class="modal-card"><div class="modal-head"><div><div class="eyebrow">SCHEDA CANDIDATO · ${esc(electionLabel())}</div><h2>${esc(candidate)}</h2><p>${esc(scope)} · ${total.toLocaleString('it-IT')} preferenze</p></div><button class="btn bg2" onclick="closeCandidate()">Chiudi ✕</button></div><div class="dash-card"><div class="card-title"><div><b>Comuni e preferenze</b><small>Ordinati dal Comune con più preferenze</small></div></div><div class="table-wrap"><table class="data-table"><thead><tr><th>#</th><th>Comune</th><th>Preferenze</th></tr></thead><tbody>${byComune.map((x,i)=>`<tr><td>${i+1}</td><td><button class="link-btn" onclick="closeCandidate();openComune(${esc(JSON.stringify(x[0]))},${JSON.stringify(rows.find(r=>r.comune===x[0])?.prov||'')})"><b>${esc(x[0])}</b></button></td><td><b>${x[1].toLocaleString('it-IT')}</b></td></tr>`).join('')}</tbody><tfoot><tr class="total-row"><td></td><td>TOTALE</td><td>${total.toLocaleString('it-IT')}</td></tr></tfoot></table></div></div></div></div>`;
  document.body.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend',html);
}
function closeCandidate(){document.querySelector('.candidate-list-modal')?.remove();}

function renderComuni(){document.getElementById('comuneFilters').innerHTML=filterHTML();let sums={};filtered().forEach(r=>{let k=r.prov+'|'+r.comune;sums[k]=(sums[k]||0)+r.preferenze});let rows=GEO.filter(g=>(!filters.prov||g.prov===filters.prov)&&(!filters.comune||g.comune===filters.comune)&&(!filters.camP||g.camP===filters.camP)&&(!filters.senP||g.senP===filters.senP)).sort((a,b)=>a.comune.localeCompare(b.comune));document.getElementById('comuneTable').innerHTML=rows.map(g=>`<tr><td><b>${esc(g.comune)}</b></td><td>${esc(g.prov)}</td><td>${esc(g.istat)}</td><td>${esc(g.camP)}</td><td>${esc(g.camU)}</td><td>${esc(g.senP)}</td><td>${esc(g.senU)}</td><td><b>${(sums[g.prov+'|'+g.comune]||0).toLocaleString('it-IT')}</b></td></tr>`).join('')}
function renderCand(){
 const body=CANDS.map(c=>{let rs=data.filter(r=>r.candidato===c),x=rs[0],t=rs.reduce((s,r)=>s+r.preferenze,0);let provs=[...new Set(rs.map(r=>r.prov))];let tickets=provs.map(p=>ticketForCandidate(c,p)).filter(Boolean);let ticketLabel=tickets.length?tickets.map(t=>t.candidates.filter(n=>n!==c).join(' + ')).join(' · '):'—';return `<tr><td><b>${esc(c)}</b></td><td>${esc(x.lista)}</td><td>${esc(x.data)}</td><td>${esc(x.luogo)}</td><td>${t.toLocaleString('it-IT')}</td><td><div style="display:flex;gap:6px"><input class="inline-input" value="${esc(correnti[c]||'')}" placeholder="Inserisci corrente" onchange="saveCorrente(${JSON.stringify(c)},this.value)"><button class="btn bg2" onclick="saveCorrente(${JSON.stringify(c)},this.previousElementSibling.value)">Salva</button></div></td><td>${esc(ticketLabel)}</td></tr>`}).join('');
 const opts=CANDS.map(c=>`<option value="${esc(c)}">`).join('');
 const provs=PROVS.map(p=>`<option value="${esc(p)}">${esc(PROV_FULL[PROV_CODE[norm(p)]]||p)}</option>`).join('');
 const tickets=ticketGroups.map(t=>`<tr><td>${esc(PROV_FULL[PROV_CODE[norm(t.prov)]]||t.prov)}</td><td><b>${t.candidates.map(esc).join(' + ')}</b></td><td>${ticketValue(t).toLocaleString('it-IT')}</td><td><button class="btn bg2" data-ticket-id="${esc(t.id)}">Elimina</button></td></tr>`).join('')||'<tr><td colspan="4" class="muted">Nessun ticket inserito.</td></tr>';
 document.getElementById('candTable').innerHTML=body;
 const host=document.getElementById('candTable').closest('.table-wrap')?.parentElement || document.getElementById('candTable').parentElement;
 const old=document.getElementById('ticketManagerInline'); if(old)old.remove();
 const panel=`<div id="ticketManagerInline" class="dash-card" style="margin-top:16px"><div class="card-title"><div><b>GESTIONE TICKET</b><small>Il ticket non somma i voti: nell'analisi della corrente viene conteggiato una sola volta il candidato con più preferenze.</small></div></div><div class="filter-bar" style="align-items:end"><label class="filter-control"><span>Provincia</span><select id="tkProv">${provs}</select></label><label class="filter-control" style="min-width:260px"><span>Candidato 1</span><input id="tkA" class="inline-input" style="width:100%" list="ticketCandidates" placeholder="Scrivi il nome del candidato"></label><label class="filter-control" style="min-width:260px"><span>Candidato 2</span><input id="tkB" class="inline-input" style="width:100%" list="ticketCandidates" placeholder="Scrivi il nome del candidato"></label><button class="btn" type="button" onclick="addTicketInline()">+ AGGIUNGI TICKET</button></div><datalist id="ticketCandidates">${opts}</datalist><div class="table-wrap" style="margin-top:14px"><table class="data-table"><thead><tr><th>Provincia</th><th>Ticket</th><th>Valore conteggiato</th><th></th></tr></thead><tbody>${tickets}</tbody></table></div></div>`;
 host.insertAdjacentHTML('afterend',panel);
 const ticketPanel=document.getElementById('ticketManagerInline');
 ticketPanel?.querySelectorAll('[data-ticket-id]').forEach(btn=>btn.addEventListener('click',()=>{ const id=btn.getAttribute('data-ticket-id'); ticketGroups=ticketGroups.filter(t=>String(t.id)!==String(id)); saveTickets(); renderCand(); }));
}
function addTicketInline(){const prov=document.getElementById('tkProv')?.value||'',a=(document.getElementById('tkA')?.value||'').trim(),b=(document.getElementById('tkB')?.value||'').trim();if(!prov||!a||!b){alert('Compila Provincia, Candidato 1 e Candidato 2.');return;}const ca=CANDS.find(c=>norm(c)===norm(a)),cb=CANDS.find(c=>norm(c)===norm(b));if(!ca||!cb){alert('I due candidati devono essere selezionati dall’elenco dei candidati.');return;}if(ca===cb){alert('Seleziona due candidati diversi.');return;}if(ticketGroups.some(t=>t.prov===prov&&t.candidates.length===2&&t.candidates.includes(ca)&&t.candidates.includes(cb))){alert('Questo ticket esiste già.');return;}ticketGroups.push({id:'T'+Date.now(),prov,candidates:[ca,cb]});saveTickets();renderCand();}

function openTicketManager(){const el=document.getElementById('ticketManagerInline');if(el)el.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth',block:'center'});}

function addTicket(){addTicketInline();}

function removeTicket(id){ticketGroups=ticketGroups.filter(t=>t.id!==id);saveTickets();document.getElementById('ticketModal')?.remove();openTicketManager();}

function listBars(a){let m=Math.max(...a.map(x=>x[1]),1);return a.map(x=>`<div class="list-bar"><span>${esc(x[0])}</span><i><em style="width:${x[1]/m*100}%"></em></i><b>${x[1].toLocaleString('it-IT')}</b></div>`).join('')||'<span class="muted">Nessun dato</span>'}
function renderCollegi(){ if(window.renderCollegi && window.renderCollegi!==renderCollegi){ return window.renderCollegi(); } }
function sumRows(rows){return rows.reduce((n,r)=>n+(Number(r.preferenze)||0),0)}
function pct(n,d){return d?((n/d)*100).toFixed(1)+'%':'0.0%'}
function groupRows(rows,key){let m={};rows.forEach(r=>{let k=key(r)||'Da classificare';m[k]=(m[k]||0)+(Number(r.preferenze)||0)});return Object.entries(m).sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1])}
function analysisRowClick(type,value){if(type==='camP'){filters.camP=value;filters.senP=''}else if(type==='senP'){filters.senP=value;filters.camP=''}else if(type==='candidato'){filters.candidato=value}render()}

function openCandidate(candidate){
  const rows=data.filter(r=>r.candidato===candidate && (!filters.prov||r.prov===filters.prov) && (!filters.comune||r.comune===filters.comune) && (!filters.lista||r.lista===filters.lista) && (!filters.corrente||r.corrente===filters.corrente));
  const byComune=agg(rows,r=>r.comune);
  const total=byComune.reduce((s,x)=>s+x[1],0);
  const scope=filters.prov?filters.prov:'Tutta la Lombardia';
  const html=`<div class="modal-backdrop candidate-list-modal" onclick="if(event.target===this)closeCandidate()"><div class="modal-card"><div class="modal-head"><div><div class="eyebrow">SCHEDA CANDIDATO · ${esc(electionLabel())}</div><h2>${esc(candidate)}</h2><p>${esc(scope)} · ${total.toLocaleString('it-IT')} preferenze</p></div><button class="btn bg2" onclick="closeCandidate()">Chiudi ✕</button></div><div class="dash-card"><div class="card-title"><div><b>Comuni e preferenze</b><small>Ordinati dal Comune con più preferenze</small></div></div><div class="table-wrap"><table class="data-table"><thead><tr><th>#</th><th>Comune</th><th>Preferenze</th></tr></thead><tbody>${byComune.map((x,i)=>`<tr><td>${i+1}</td><td><button class="link-btn" onclick="closeCandidate();openComune(${esc(JSON.stringify(x[0]))},${JSON.stringify(rows.find(r=>r.comune===x[0])?.prov||'')})"><b>${esc(x[0])}</b></button></td><td><b>${x[1].toLocaleString('it-IT')}</b></td></tr>`).join('')}</tbody><tfoot><tr class="total-row"><td></td><td>TOTALE</td><td>${total.toLocaleString('it-IT')}</td></tr></tfoot></table></div></div></div></div>`;

function openCandidate(candidate){
  const rows=data.filter(r=>r.candidato===candidate && (!filters.prov||r.prov===filters.prov) && (!filters.comune||r.comune===filters.comune) && (!filters.lista||r.lista===filters.lista) && (!filters.corrente||r.corrente===filters.corrente));
  const byComune=agg(rows,r=>r.comune);
  const total=byComune.reduce((s,x)=>s+x[1],0);
  const scope=filters.prov?filters.prov:'Tutta la Lombardia';
  const html=`<div class="modal-backdrop candidate-list-modal" onclick="if(event.target===this)closeCandidate()"><div class="modal-card"><div class="modal-head"><div><div class="eyebrow">SCHEDA CANDIDATO · ${esc(electionLabel())}</div><h2>${esc(candidate)}</h2><p>${esc(scope)} · ${total.toLocaleString('it-IT')} preferenze</p></div><button class="btn bg2" onclick="closeCandidate()">Chiudi ✕</button></div><div class="dash-card"><div class="card-title"><div><b>Comuni e preferenze</b><small>Ordinati dal Comune con più preferenze</small></div></div><div class="table-wrap"><table class="data-table"><thead><tr><th>#</th><th>Comune</th><th>Preferenze</th></tr></thead><tbody>${byComune.map((x,i)=>`<tr><td>${i+1}</td><td><button class="link-btn" onclick="closeCandidate();openComune(${esc(JSON.stringify(x[0]))},${JSON.stringify(rows.find(r=>r.comune===x[0])?.prov||'')})"><b>${esc(x[0])}</b></button></td><td><b>${x[1].toLocaleString('it-IT')}</b></td></tr>`).join('')}</tbody><tfoot><tr class="total-row"><td></td><td>TOTALE</td><td>${total.toLocaleString('it-IT')}</td></tr></tfoot></table></div></div></div></div>`;
  document.body.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend',html);
}
function closeCandidate(){document.querySelector('.candidate-list-modal')?.remove();}

function renderComuni(){document.getElementById('comuneFilters').innerHTML=filterHTML();let sums={};filtered().forEach(r=>{let k=r.prov+'|'+r.comune;sums[k]=(sums[k]||0)+r.preferenze});let rows=GEO.filter(g=>(!filters.prov||g.prov===filters.prov)&&(!filters.comune||g.comune===filters.comune)&&(!filters.camP||g.camP===filters.camP)&&(!filters.senP||g.senP===filters.senP)).sort((a,b)=>a.comune.localeCompare(b.comune));document.getElementById('comuneTable').innerHTML=rows.map(g=>`<tr><td><b>${esc(g.comune)}</b></td><td>${esc(g.prov)}</td><td>${esc(g.istat)}</td><td>${esc(g.camP)}</td><td>${esc(g.camU)}</td><td>${esc(g.senP)}</td><td>${esc(g.senU)}</td><td><b>${(sums[g.prov+'|'+g.comune]||0).toLocaleString('it-IT')}</b></td></tr>`).join('')}
function renderCand(){
 const body=CANDS.map(c=>{let rs=data.filter(r=>r.candidato===c),x=rs[0],t=rs.reduce((s,r)=>s+r.preferenze,0);let provs=[...new Set(rs.map(r=>r.prov))];let tickets=provs.map(p=>ticketForCandidate(c,p)).filter(Boolean);let ticketLabel=tickets.length?tickets.map(t=>t.candidates.filter(n=>n!==c).join(' + ')).join(' · '):'—';return `<tr><td><b>${esc(c)}</b></td><td>${esc(x.lista)}</td><td>${esc(x.data)}</td><td>${esc(x.luogo)}</td><td>${t.toLocaleString('it-IT')}</td><td><div style="display:flex;gap:6px"><input class="inline-input" value="${esc(correnti[c]||'')}" placeholder="Inserisci corrente" onchange="saveCorrente(${JSON.stringify(c)},this.value)"><button class="btn bg2" onclick="saveCorrente(${JSON.stringify(c)},this.previousElementSibling.value)">Salva</button></div></td><td>${esc(ticketLabel)}</td></tr>`}).join('');
 const opts=CANDS.map(c=>`<option value="${esc(c)}">`).join('');
 const provs=PROVS.map(p=>`<option value="${esc(p)}">${esc(PROV_FULL[PROV_CODE[norm(p)]]||p)}</option>`).join('');
 const tickets=ticketGroups.map(t=>`<tr><td>${esc(PROV_FULL[PROV_CODE[norm(t.prov)]]||t.prov)}</td><td><b>${t.candidates.map(esc).join(' + ')}</b></td><td>${ticketValue(t).toLocaleString('it-IT')}</td><td><button class="btn bg2" data-ticket-id="${esc(t.id)}">Elimina</button></td></tr>`).join('')||'<tr><td colspan="4" class="muted">Nessun ticket inserito.</td></tr>';
 document.getElementById('candTable').innerHTML=body;
 const host=document.getElementById('candTable').closest('.table-wrap')?.parentElement || document.getElementById('candTable').parentElement;
 const old=document.getElementById('ticketManagerInline'); if(old)old.remove();
 const panel=`<div id="ticketManagerInline" class="dash-card" style="margin-top:16px"><div class="card-title"><div><b>GESTIONE TICKET</b><small>Il ticket non somma i voti: nell'analisi della corrente viene conteggiato una sola volta il candidato con più preferenze.</small></div></div><div class="filter-bar" style="align-items:end"><label class="filter-control"><span>Provincia</span><select id="tkProv">${provs}</select></label><label class="filter-control" style="min-width:260px"><span>Candidato 1</span><input id="tkA" class="inline-input" style="width:100%" list="ticketCandidates" placeholder="Scrivi il nome del candidato"></label><label class="filter-control" style="min-width:260px"><span>Candidato 2</span><input id="tkB" class="inline-input" style="width:100%" list="ticketCandidates" placeholder="Scrivi il nome del candidato"></label><button class="btn" type="button" onclick="addTicketInline()">+ AGGIUNGI TICKET</button></div><datalist id="ticketCandidates">${opts}</datalist><div class="table-wrap" style="margin-top:14px"><table class="data-table"><thead><tr><th>Provincia</th><th>Ticket</th><th>Valore conteggiato</th><th></th></tr></thead><tbody>${tickets}</tbody></table></div></div>`;
 host.insertAdjacentHTML('afterend',panel);
 const ticketPanel=document.getElementById('ticketManagerInline');
 ticketPanel?.querySelectorAll('[data-ticket-id]').forEach(btn=>btn.addEventListener('click',()=>{ const id=btn.getAttribute('data-ticket-id'); ticketGroups=ticketGroups.filter(t=>String(t.id)!==String(id)); saveTickets(); renderCand(); }));
}
function addTicketInline(){const prov=document.getElementById('tkProv')?.value||'',a=(document.getElementById('tkA')?.value||'').trim(),b=(document.getElementById('tkB')?.value||'').trim();if(!prov||!a||!b){alert('Compila Provincia, Candidato 1 e Candidato 2.');return;}const ca=CANDS.find(c=>norm(c)===norm(a)),cb=CANDS.find(c=>norm(c)===norm(b));if(!ca||!cb){alert('I due candidati devono essere selezionati dall’elenco dei candidati.');return;}if(ca===cb){alert('Seleziona due candidati diversi.');return;}if(ticketGroups.some(t=>t.prov===prov&&t.candidates.length===2&&t.candidates.includes(ca)&&t.candidates.includes(cb))){alert('Questo ticket esiste già.');return;}ticketGroups.push({id:'T'+Date.now(),prov,candidates:[ca,cb]});saveTickets();renderCand();}

function openTicketManager(){const el=document.getElementById('ticketManagerInline');if(el)el.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth',block:'center'});}

function addTicket(){addTicketInline();}

function removeTicket(id){ticketGroups=ticketGroups.filter(t=>t.id!==id);saveTickets();document.getElementById('ticketModal')?.remove();openTicketManager();}

function listBars(a){let m=Math.max(...a.map(x=>x[1]),1);return a.map(x=>`<div class="list-bar"><span>${esc(x[0])}</span><i><em style="width:${x[1]/m*100}%"></em></i><b>${x[1].toLocaleString('it-IT')}</b></div>`).join('')||'<span class="muted">Nessun dato</span>'}
function renderCollegi(){ if(window.renderCollegi && window.renderCollegi!==renderCollegi){ return window.renderCollegi(); } }
function sumRows(rows){return rows.reduce((n,r)=>n+(Number(r.preferenze)||0),0)}
function pct(n,d){return d?((n/d)*100).toFixed(1)+'%':'0.0%'}
function groupRows(rows,key){let m={};rows.forEach(r=>{let k=key(r)||'Da classificare';m[k]=(m[k]||0)+(Number(r.preferenze)||0)});return Object.entries(m).sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1])}
function analysisRowClick(type,value){if(type==='camP'){filters.camP=value;filters.senP=''}else if(type==='senP'){filters.senP=value;filters.camP=''}else if(type==='candidato'){filters.candidato=value}render()}
function analysisTable(rows,totalVal,type){return rows.slice(0,40).map((x,i)=>`<tr><td>${i+1}</td><td><button class="link-btn" onclick="analysisRowClick('${type}',${esc(JSON.stringify(x[0]))})">${esc(x[0])}</button></td><td>${x[1].toLocaleString('it-IT')}</td><td>${pct(x[1],totalVal)}</td></tr>`).join('')||'<tr><td colspan="4">Nessun dato</td></tr>'}

 const body=CANDS.map(c=>{let rs=data.filter(r=>r.candidato===c),x=rs[0],t=rs.reduce((s,r)=>s+r.preferenze,0);let provs=[...new Set(rs.map(r=>r.prov))];let tickets=provs.map(p=>ticketForCandidate(c,p)).filter(Boolean);let ticketLabel=tickets.length?tickets.map(t=>t.candidates.filter(n=>n!==c).join(' + ')).join(' · '):'—';return `<tr><td><b>${esc(c)}</b></td><td>${esc(x.lista)}</td><td>${esc(x.data)}</td><td>${esc(x.luogo)}</td><td>${t.toLocaleString('it-IT')}</td><td><div style="display:flex;gap:6px"><input class="inline-input" value="${esc(correnti[c]||'')}" placeholder="Inserisci corrente" onchange="saveCorrente(${JSON.stringify(c)},this.value)"><button class="btn bg2" onclick="saveCorrente(${JSON.stringify(c)},this.previousElementSibling.value)">Salva</button></div></td><td>${esc(ticketLabel)}</td></tr>`}).join('');
 const opts=CANDS.map(c=>`<option value="${esc(c)}">`).join('');
 const provs=PROVS.map(p=>`<option value="${esc(p)}">${esc(PROV_FULL[PROV_CODE[norm(p)]]||p)}</option>`).join('');
 const tickets=ticketGroups.map(t=>`<tr><td>${esc(PROV_FULL[PROV_CODE[norm(t.prov)]]||t.prov)}</td><td><b>${t.candidates.map(esc).join(' + ')}</b></td><td>${ticketValue(t).toLocaleString('it-IT')}</td><td><button class="btn bg2" data-ticket-id="${esc(t.id)}">Elimina</button></td></tr>`).join('')||'<tr><td colspan="4" class="muted">Nessun ticket inserito.</td></tr>';
 document.getElementById('candTable').innerHTML=body;
 const host=document.getElementById('candTable').closest('.table-wrap')?.parentElement || document.getElementById('candTable').parentElement;
 const old=document.getElementById('ticketManagerInline'); if(old)old.remove();
 const panel=`<div id="ticketManagerInline" class="dash-card" style="margin-top:16px"><div class="card-title"><div><b>GESTIONE TICKET</b><small>Il ticket non somma i voti: nell'analisi della corrente viene conteggiato una sola volta il candidato con più preferenze.</small></div></div><div class="filter-bar" style="align-items:end"><label class="filter-control"><span>Provincia</span><select id="tkProv">${provs}</select></label><label class="filter-control" style="min-width:260px"><span>Candidato 1</span><input id="tkA" class="inline-input" style="width:100%" list="ticketCandidates" placeholder="Scrivi il nome del candidato"></label><label class="filter-control" style="min-width:260px"><span>Candidato 2</span><input id="tkB" class="inline-input" style="width:100%" list="ticketCandidates" placeholder="Scrivi il nome del candidato"></label><button class="btn" type="button" onclick="addTicketInline()">+ AGGIUNGI TICKET</button></div><datalist id="ticketCandidates">${opts}</datalist><div class="table-wrap" style="margin-top:14px"><table class="data-table"><thead><tr><th>Provincia</th><th>Ticket</th><th>Valore conteggiato</th><th></th></tr></thead><tbody>${tickets}</tbody></table></div></div>`;
 host.insertAdjacentHTML('afterend',panel);

}
function addTicketInline(){const prov=document.getElementById('tkProv')?.value||'',a=(document.getElementById('tkA')?.value||'').trim(),b=(document.getElementById('tkB')?.value||'').trim();if(!prov||!a||!b){alert('Compila Provincia, Candidato 1 e Candidato 2.');return;}const ca=CANDS.find(c=>norm(c)===norm(a)),cb=CANDS.find(c=>norm(c)===norm(b));if(!ca||!cb){alert('I due candidati devono essere selezionati dall’elenco dei candidati.');return;}if(ca===cb){alert('Seleziona due candidati diversi.');return;}if(ticketGroups.some(t=>t.prov===prov&&t.candidates.length===2&&t.candidates.includes(ca)&&t.candidates.includes(cb))){alert('Questo ticket esiste già.');return;}ticketGroups.push({id:'T'+Date.now(),prov,candidates:[ca,cb]});saveTickets();renderCand();}

function listBars(a){let m=Math.max(...a.map(x=>x[1]),1);return a.map(x=>`<div class="list-bar"><span>${esc(x[0])}</span><i><em style="width:${x[1]/m*100}%"></em></i><b>${x[1].toLocaleString('it-IT')}</b></div>`).join('')||'<span class="muted">Nessun dato</span>'}

function sumRows(rows){return rows.reduce((n,r)=>n+(Number(r.preferenze)||0),0)}
function pct(n,d){return d?((n/d)*100).toFixed(1)+'%':'0.0%'}
function groupRows(rows,key){let m={};rows.forEach(r=>{let k=key(r)||'Da classificare';m[k]=(m[k]||0)+(Number(r.preferenze)||0)});return Object.entries(m).sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1])}
function analysisRowClick(type,value){if(type==='camP'){filters.camP=value;filters.senP=''}else if(type==='senP'){filters.senP=value;filters.camP=''}else if(type==='candidato'){filters.candidato=value}render()}
function analysisTable(rows,totalVal,type){return rows.slice(0,40).map((x,i)=>`<tr><td>${i+1}</td><td><button class="link-btn" onclick="analysisRowClick('${type}',${esc(JSON.stringify(x[0]))})">${esc(x[0])}</button></td><td>${x[1].toLocaleString('it-IT')}</td><td>${pct(x[1],totalVal)}</td></tr>`).join('')||'<tr><td colspan="4">Nessun dato</td></tr>'}

function addTicketInline(){const prov=document.getElementById('tkProv')?.value||'',a=(document.getElementById('tkA')?.value||'').trim(),b=(document.getElementById('tkB')?.value||'').trim();if(!prov||!a||!b){alert('Compila Provincia, Candidato 1 e Candidato 2.');return;}const ca=CANDS.find(c=>norm(c)===norm(a)),cb=CANDS.find(c=>norm(c)===norm(b));if(!ca||!cb){alert('I due candidati devono essere selezionati dall’elenco dei candidati.');return;}if(ca===cb){alert('Seleziona due candidati diversi.');return;}if(ticketGroups.some(t=>t.prov===prov&&t.candidates.length===2&&t.candidates.includes(ca)&&t.candidates.includes(cb))){alert('Questo ticket esiste già.');return;}ticketGroups.push({id:'T'+Date.now(),prov,candidates:[ca,cb]});saveTickets();renderCand();}

 const body=CANDS.map(c=>{let rs=data.filter(r=>r.candidato===c),x=rs[0],t=rs.reduce((s,r)=>s+r.preferenze,0);let provs=[...new Set(rs.map(r=>r.prov))];let tickets=provs.map(p=>ticketForCandidate(c,p)).filter(Boolean);let ticketLabel=tickets.length?tickets.map(t=>t.candidates.filter(n=>n!==c).join(' + ')).join(' · '):'—';return `<tr><td><b>${esc(c)}</b></td><td>${esc(x.lista)}</td><td>${esc(x.data)}</td><td>${esc(x.luogo)}</td><td>${t.toLocaleString('it-IT')}</td><td><div style="display:flex;gap:6px"><input class="inline-input" value="${esc(correnti[c]||'')}" placeholder="Inserisci corrente" onchange="saveCorrente(${JSON.stringify(c)},this.value)"><button class="btn bg2" onclick="saveCorrente(${JSON.stringify(c)},this.previousElementSibling.value)">Salva</button></div></td><td>${esc(ticketLabel)}</td></tr>`}).join('');
 const opts=CANDS.map(c=>`<option value="${esc(c)}">`).join('');
 const provs=PROVS.map(p=>`<option value="${esc(p)}">${esc(PROV_FULL[PROV_CODE[norm(p)]]||p)}</option>`).join('');
 const tickets=ticketGroups.map(t=>`<tr><td>${esc(PROV_FULL[PROV_CODE[norm(t.prov)]]||t.prov)}</td><td><b>${t.candidates.map(esc).join(' + ')}</b></td><td>${ticketValue(t).toLocaleString('it-IT')}</td><td><button class="btn bg2" data-ticket-id="${esc(t.id)}">Elimina</button></td></tr>`).join('')||'<tr><td colspan="4" class="muted">Nessun ticket inserito.</td></tr>';
 document.getElementById('candTable').innerHTML=body;
 const host=document.getElementById('candTable').closest('.table-wrap')?.parentElement || document.getElementById('candTable').parentElement;
 const old=document.getElementById('ticketManagerInline'); if(old)old.remove();
 const panel=`<div id="ticketManagerInline" class="dash-card" style="margin-top:16px"><div class="card-title"><div><b>GESTIONE TICKET</b><small>Il ticket non somma i voti: nell'analisi della corrente viene conteggiato una sola volta il candidato con più preferenze.</small></div></div><div class="filter-bar" style="align-items:end"><label class="filter-control"><span>Provincia</span><select id="tkProv">${provs}</select></label><label class="filter-control" style="min-width:260px"><span>Candidato 1</span><input id="tkA" class="inline-input" style="width:100%" list="ticketCandidates" placeholder="Scrivi il nome del candidato"></label><label class="filter-control" style="min-width:260px"><span>Candidato 2</span><input id="tkB" class="inline-input" style="width:100%" list="ticketCandidates" placeholder="Scrivi il nome del candidato"></label><button class="btn" type="button" onclick="addTicketInline()">+ AGGIUNGI TICKET</button></div><datalist id="ticketCandidates">${opts}</datalist><div class="table-wrap" style="margin-top:14px"><table class="data-table"><thead><tr><th>Provincia</th><th>Ticket</th><th>Valore conteggiato</th><th></th></tr></thead><tbody>${tickets}</tbody></table></div></div>`;
 host.insertAdjacentHTML('afterend',panel);
 const ticketPanel=document.getElementById('ticketManagerInline');
 ticketPanel?.querySelectorAll('[data-ticket-id]').forEach(btn=>btn.addEventListener('click',()=>{ const id=btn.getAttribute('data-ticket-id'); ticketGroups=ticketGroups.filter(t=>String(t.id)!==String(id)); saveTickets(); renderCand(); }));
}
function addTicketInline(){const prov=document.getElementById('tkProv')?.value||'',a=(document.getElementById('tkA')?.value||'').trim(),b=(document.getElementById('tkB')?.value||'').trim();if(!prov||!a||!b){alert('Compila Provincia, Candidato 1 e Candidato 2.');return;}const ca=CANDS.find(c=>norm(c)===norm(a)),cb=CANDS.find(c=>norm(c)===norm(b));if(!ca||!cb){alert('I due candidati devono essere selezionati dall’elenco dei candidati.');return;}if(ca===cb){alert('Seleziona due candidati diversi.');return;}if(ticketGroups.some(t=>t.prov===prov&&t.candidates.length===2&&t.candidates.includes(ca)&&t.candidates.includes(cb))){alert('Questo ticket esiste già.');return;}ticketGroups.push({id:'T'+Date.now(),prov,candidates:[ca,cb]});saveTickets();renderCand();}

function openTicketManager(){const el=document.getElementById('ticketManagerInline');if(el)el.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth',block:'center'});}

function addTicket(){addTicketInline();}

function removeTicket(id){ticketGroups=ticketGroups.filter(t=>t.id!==id);saveTickets();document.getElementById('ticketModal')?.remove();openTicketManager();}

function listBars(a){let m=Math.max(...a.map(x=>x[1]),1);return a.map(x=>`<div class="list-bar"><span>${esc(x[0])}</span><i><em style="width:${x[1]/m*100}%"></em></i><b>${x[1].toLocaleString('it-IT')}</b></div>`).join('')||'<span class="muted">Nessun dato</span>'}
function renderCollegi(){ if(window.renderCollegi && window.renderCollegi!==renderCollegi){ return window.renderCollegi(); } }
function sumRows(rows){return rows.reduce((n,r)=>n+(Number(r.preferenze)||0),0)}
function pct(n,d){return d?((n/d)*100).toFixed(1)+'%':'0.0%'}
function groupRows(rows,key){let m={};rows.forEach(r=>{let k=key(r)||'Da classificare';m[k]=(m[k]||0)+(Number(r.preferenze)||0)});return Object.entries(m).sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1])}
function analysisRowClick(type,value){if(type==='camP'){filters.camP=value;filters.senP=''}else if(type==='senP'){filters.senP=value;filters.camP=''}else if(type==='candidato'){filters.candidato=value}render()}
function analysisTable(rows,totalVal,type){return rows.slice(0,40).map((x,i)=>`<tr><td>${i+1}</td><td><button class="link-btn" onclick="analysisRowClick('${type}',${esc(JSON.stringify(x[0]))})">${esc(x[0])}</button></td><td>${x[1].toLocaleString('it-IT')}</td><td>${pct(x[1],totalVal)}</td></tr>`).join('')||'<tr><td colspan="4">Nessun dato</td></tr>'}

 const kpis=[['PREFERENZE',t.toLocaleString('it-IT'),'nel perimetro filtrato'],['CANDIDATI',new Set(r.map(x=>x.candidato)).size,'presenti nel filtro'],['COMUNI',new Set(r.map(x=>x.comune)).size,'coperti dai dati'],['PROVINCE',new Set(r.map(x=>x.prov)).size,'presenti nel filtro'],['CAMERA',new Set(r.map(x=>x.geo?.camP).filter(Boolean)).size,'collegi presenti'],['SENATO',new Set(r.map(x=>x.geo?.senP).filter(Boolean)).size,'collegi presenti'],['CORRENTI',new Set(r.map(x=>x.corrente).filter(Boolean)).size,election==='regionali'?'correnti assegnate':'disponibili solo sulle Regionali']];
 document.getElementById('analisiKpi').innerHTML=kpis.map(k=>`<section class="dash-card"><div class="card-title"><b>${k[0]}</b></div><div style="font-size:28px;font-weight:800">${k[1]}</div><small>${k[2]}</small></section>`).join('');
 document.getElementById('correnteBars').innerHTML=election==='regionali' ? (corr.map(x=>`<div class="metric-row"><div><b>${esc(x[0])}</b><span>${x[1].toLocaleString('it-IT')} · ${pct(x[1],corrTotal)}</span></div><div class="metric-track"><i style="width:${t?x[1]/t*100:0}%"></i></div></div>`).join('')||'<div class="empty-state">Nessuna corrente assegnata.</div>') : '<div class="empty-state"><b>Le correnti sono una classificazione delle Regionali 2023.</b><span>Passa a DATI REGIONALI per analizzarle.</span></div>';

 document.getElementById('analisiSen').innerHTML=sen.map(x=>`<div class="metric-row"><div><button class="link-btn" onclick="analysisRowClick('senP',${esc(JSON.stringify(x[0]))})"><b>${esc(x[0])}</b></button><span>${x[1].toLocaleString('it-IT')} · ${pct(x[1],t)}</span></div><div class="metric-track"><i style="width:${t?x[1]/t*100:0}%"></i></div></div>`).join('')||'<div class="empty-state">Nessun collegio.</div>';

 const selectedRow=filters.candidato?cand.find(x=>x[0]===filters.candidato):cand[0];
 if(selectedRow){

function addTicketInline(){const prov=document.getElementById('tkProv')?.value||'',a=(document.getElementById('tkA')?.value||'').trim(),b=(document.getElementById('tkB')?.value||'').trim();if(!prov||!a||!b){alert('Compila Provincia, Candidato 1 e Candidato 2.');return;}const ca=CANDS.find(c=>norm(c)===norm(a)),cb=CANDS.find(c=>norm(c)===norm(b));if(!ca||!cb){alert('I due candidati devono essere selezionati dall’elenco dei candidati.');return;}if(ca===cb){alert('Seleziona due candidati diversi.');return;}if(ticketGroups.some(t=>t.prov===prov&&t.candidates.length===2&&t.candidates.includes(ca)&&t.candidates.includes(cb))){alert('Questo ticket esiste già.');return;}ticketGroups.push({id:'T'+Date.now(),prov,candidates:[ca,cb]});saveTickets();renderCand();}

function addTicketInline(){const prov=document.getElementById('tkProv')?.value||'',a=(document.getElementById('tkA')?.value||'').trim(),b=(document.getElementById('tkB')?.value||'').trim();if(!prov||!a||!b){alert('Compila Provincia, Candidato 1 e Candidato 2.');return;}const ca=CANDS.find(c=>norm(c)===norm(a)),cb=CANDS.find(c=>norm(c)===norm(b));if(!ca||!cb){alert('I due candidati devono essere selezionati dall’elenco dei candidati.');return;}if(ca===cb){alert('Seleziona due candidati diversi.');return;}if(ticketGroups.some(t=>t.prov===prov&&t.candidates.length===2&&t.candidates.includes(ca)&&t.candidates.includes(cb))){alert('Questo ticket esiste già.');return;}ticketGroups.push({id:'T'+Date.now(),prov,candidates:[ca,cb]});saveTickets();renderCand();}

function openTicketManager(){const el=document.getElementById('ticketManagerInline');if(el)el.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth',block:'center'});}

function addTicketInline(){const prov=document.getElementById('tkProv')?.value||'',a=(document.getElementById('tkA')?.value||'').trim(),b=(document.getElementById('tkB')?.value||'').trim();if(!prov||!a||!b){alert('Compila Provincia, Candidato 1 e Candidato 2.');return;}const ca=CANDS.find(c=>norm(c)===norm(a)),cb=CANDS.find(c=>norm(c)===norm(b));if(!ca||!cb){alert('I due candidati devono essere selezionati dall’elenco dei candidati.');return;}if(ca===cb){alert('Seleziona due candidati diversi.');return;}if(ticketGroups.some(t=>t.prov===prov&&t.candidates.length===2&&t.candidates.includes(ca)&&t.candidates.includes(cb))){alert('Questo ticket esiste già.');return;}ticketGroups.push({id:'T'+Date.now(),prov,candidates:[ca,cb]});saveTickets();renderCand();}

function addTicketInline(){const prov=document.getElementById('tkProv')?.value||'',a=(document.getElementById('tkA')?.value||'').trim(),b=(document.getElementById('tkB')?.value||'').trim();if(!prov||!a||!b){alert('Compila Provincia, Candidato 1 e Candidato 2.');return;}const ca=CANDS.find(c=>norm(c)===norm(a)),cb=CANDS.find(c=>norm(c)===norm(b));if(!ca||!cb){alert('I due candidati devono essere selezionati dall’elenco dei candidati.');return;}if(ca===cb){alert('Seleziona due candidati diversi.');return;}if(ticketGroups.some(t=>t.prov===prov&&t.candidates.length===2&&t.candidates.includes(ca)&&t.candidates.includes(cb))){alert('Questo ticket esiste già.');return;}ticketGroups.push({id:'T'+Date.now(),prov,candidates:[ca,cb]});saveTickets();renderCand();}

 function correnteCollegioTable(type){if(election!=='regionali')return '<div class="empty-state">Le correnti sono disponibili solo sulle Regionali 2023.</div>';const key=type==='cam'?x=>x.geo?.camP:x=>x.geo?.senP;const by=effectiveCurrentBy(r,key);const cols=[...new Set(r.map(x=>key(x)).filter(Boolean))];const cs=[...new Set(Object.values(by).flatMap(o=>Object.keys(o)))].sort();const grand=cs.reduce((s,c)=>s+cols.reduce((a,col)=>a+(by[col]?.[c]||0),0),0);return `<table class="data-table"><thead><tr><th>Corrente</th>${cols.map(c=>`<th>${esc(c)}</th>`).join('')}<th>Totale</th><th>%</th></tr></thead><tbody>${cs.map(c=>{const tot=cols.reduce((a,col)=>a+(by[col]?.[c]||0),0);return `<tr><td><b>${esc(c)}</b></td>${cols.map(col=>{const v=by[col]?.[c]||0;const colTot=Object.values(by[col]||{}).reduce((a,n)=>a+n,0);return `<td>${v.toLocaleString('it-IT')} <small>(${pct(v,colTot)})</small></td>`}).join('')}<td>${tot.toLocaleString('it-IT')}</td><td>${pct(tot,grand)}</td></tr>`}).join('')}</tbody></table>`}
 document.getElementById('analisiCorrenteCam').innerHTML=correnteCollegioTable('cam'); document.getElementById('analisiCorrenteSen').innerHTML=correnteCollegioTable('sen');
 const topProv=prov[0], topCand=cand[0], topCorr=corr[0]; document.getElementById('analisiInsight').innerHTML=`<div class="status-list"><div><b>${topProv?esc(topProv[0]):'—'}</b><span>provincia più forte</span></div><div><b>${topCand?esc(topCand[0]):'—'}</b><span>candidato n.1 · ${topCand?pct(topCand[1],t):'—'}</span></div><div><b>${election==='regionali'&&topCorr?esc(topCorr[0]):'—'}</b><span>${election==='regionali'&&topCorr?'corrente n.1 · '+pct(topCorr[1],t):'analisi correnti non disponibile'}</span></div><div><b>${cam[0]?esc(cam[0][0]):'—'}</b><span>collegio Camera più forte</span></div><div><b>${sen[0]?esc(sen[0][0]):'—'}</b><span>collegio Senato più forte</span></div><div><b>${topComuni[0]?esc(topComuni[0][0]):'—'}</b><span>comune più forte</span></div></div>`;
}
function exportAnalysisAdvanced(){const r=filtered(),out=['TIPO;NOME;PREFERENZE;PERCENTUALE'];groupRows(r,x=>x.corrente).forEach(x=>out.push(`CORRENTE;"${String(x[0]).replace(/"/g,'""')}";${x[1]};${pct(x[1],sumRows(r))}`));groupRows(r,x=>x.candidato).forEach(x=>out.push(`CANDIDATO;"${String(x[0]).replace(/"/g,'""')}";${x[1]};${pct(x[1],sumRows(r))}`));groupRows(r,x=>x.geo?.camP).forEach(x=>out.push(`CAMERA;"${String(x[0]).replace(/"/g,'""')}";${x[1]};${pct(x[1],sumRows(r))}`));groupRows(r,x=>x.geo?.senP).forEach(x=>out.push(`SENATO;"${String(x[0]).replace(/"/g,'""')}";${x[1]};${pct(x[1],sumRows(r))}`));download(out.join('\n'),'analisi_avanzata_lombardia.csv','text/csv;charset=utf-8')}

function renderCorrenti(){let a=effectiveCurrentTotals(data),t=a.reduce((s,x)=>s+x[1],0);document.getElementById('correntiTable').innerHTML=a.map(x=>`<tr><td><b>${esc(x[0])}</b></td><td>${new Set(data.filter(r=>(correnti[r.candidato]||'Da classificare')===x[0]).map(r=>r.candidato)).size}</td><td>${x[1].toLocaleString('it-IT')}</td><td>${t?((x[1]/t)*100).toFixed(2):'0.00'}%</td></tr>`).join('')} 
function render(){applyCorrenti();renderHome();if(current==='preferenze')renderPref();if(current==='comuni')renderComuni();if(current==='candidati')renderCand();if(current==='collegi')renderCollegi();if(current==='analisi')renderAnalisi();if(current==='correnti')renderCorrenti()}
function searchGlobal(){let q=prompt('Cerca comune, candidato o collegio:');if(!q)return;let n=norm(q),c=CANDS.find(x=>norm(x).includes(n)),g=GEO.find(x=>norm(x.comune).includes(n));if(c){filters={prov:'',comune:'',candidato:c,corrente:'',camP:'',senP:'',lista:''};tab('preferenze',document.querySelector('[onclick*=preferenze]'))}else if(g){filters={...filters,prov:g.prov,comune:g.comune};tab('comuni',document.querySelector('[onclick*=comuni]'))}else alert('Nessun risultato')}
function exportCSV(){let rows=filtered(),out='PROVINCIA;COMUNE;CANDIDATO;LISTA;CORRENTE;PREFERENZE;CAMERA_P;SENATO_P\n'+rows.map(r=>[r.prov,r.comune,r.candidato,r.lista,r.corrente||'',r.preferenze,r.geo?.camP||'',r.geo?.senP||''].map(v=>`"${String(v).replace(/"/g,'""')}"`).join(';')).join('\n');download(out,'preferenze_lombardia_filtrate.csv','text/csv;charset=utf-8')}
function exportAnalysis(){let a=agg(filtered(),r=>r.corrente),out='CORRENTE;PREFERENZE\n'+a.map(x=>`"${x[0]}";${x[1]}`).join('\n');download(out,'analisi_correnti_lombardia.csv','text/csv;charset=utf-8')}
function download(t,n,m){let a=document.createElement('a');a.href=URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([t],{type:m}));a.download=n;a.click()}
function toggleTheme(){document.body.classList.toggle('light-mode')}
function resetCorrenti(){if(confirm('Cancellare tutte le correnti assegnate?')){correnti={};localStorage.removeItem('lombardia_correnti_2026');ticketGroups=[];localStorage.removeItem('lombardia_ticket_2026');render()}}
